title: Thesis Worker 30 hp - Integrating Wear and Sensor information
description:
**30 hp – Integrating Wear and Sensor information to predict Remaining Useful Life using Data-driven methods
   

  

 Introduction**
 Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project.
   

  

**Background**
 TRATON GROUP is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers, with brands including Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. Its portfolio covers light commercial vehicles, trucks and buses, complemented by financing, charging and digital logistics services. Through its global operations, production sites and extensive sales and service networks, TRATON has access to diverse vehicle platforms, real-world operational data and fleet deployment environments. This provides a strong foundation for developing and validating innovative solutions for sustainable and efficient transportation.
   

  

 In the Cloud and Embedded Plattform domain within TRATON, we develop new solutions for connected vehicles in our Internet of Things (IoT) platform, as part of TRATON’s increasing focus on communication, services and smart transport solutions. Advanced data analysis capabilities are a cornerstone enabler in this development.
   

  

**Target/scope**
 Modern connected vehicles and industrial systems are increasingly equipped with sensors that continuously monitor their condition. This enables a shift from reactive to predictive maintenance, where decisions are based on the expected Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of components.
   

  

 RUL prediction relies on two complementary information sources: wear factors, which describe accumulated degradation through usage and operating conditions, and sensor factors, which reflect the current observed state of the system.
   

  

 Our recent work [1] proposes a probabilistic framework that combines these two sources using a survival-based aging model and a data-driven model, enabling not only RUL estimation but also associated prediction uncertainty.
   

  

 The objective of this thesis is to implement and extend this framework, and to investigate how different modelling and uncertainty quantification choices affect RUL prediction performance and reliability.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The thesis will investigate probabilistic fusion of wear-based and sensor-based models for Remaining Useful Life prediction. This work will include:
   

  

  

* Reproduce and validate the proposed framework: Implement and evaluate the approach presented in [1], including the survival-based aging model, neural-network-based RUL model, and their probabilistic combination.
* Explore alternative modelling approaches: Investigate alternatives to the Weibull survival model and/or neural-network architecture used in [1]. Evaluate how different modelling assumptions influence RUL prediction and uncertainty.
* Evaluate generalisation across datasets: Test the framework on additional datasets and operating conditions to study its robustness and ability to generalise beyond the original experimental setting.
* Investigate uncertainty quantification for RUL prediction: Compare different approaches for estimating predictive uncertainty and study their effect on the resulting RUL distributions, prediction intervals, calibration and accuracy.


 If time permits, investigate extensions that relax the proxy assumption used in the data-generating formulation in [1], with the aim of developing a more general relationship between wear, latent component health, sensor observations, and failure.
   

  

 The thesis provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, survival analysis, uncertainty quantification and predictive maintenance, with both methodological research questions and applications to real-world industrial systems.
   

  

**Reference**
 [1] Srinivasan, Abhishek, et al. "Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics." PHM Society European Conference. Vol. 9. No. 1. 2026.
   

  

**Education/line/direction**
 Masters programmes in Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Complex Adaptive Systems or similar.
   

  

 Number of students: 1
   

  

 Start date for the Thesis project: Spring 2027
   

  

 Estimated timescale: 20 weeks

 Abhishek Srinivasan, Data Scientist, 08-553 816 96, abhishek.srinivasan@scania.com
   

  

 Juan Carlos Andresen,Group Manager, 08-553 835 16, juan-carlos.andresen@scania.com
   

  

**Application**
 Your application should contain the following:
   

  

  

* CV,
* personal letter,

 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.
   

  

 They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.
   

  

 At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.
   

  

 Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and dedicated support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

 Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.

 Our Solutions Architecture team empowers innovators to invent on behalf of customers. We are obsessed with understanding each customer's unique objectives to deliver optimal architectures tailored to their needs. Our culture celebrates talented, curious, motivated team members who take ownership of projects. We move with urgency, take risks, learn continuously, and maintain a friendly, inclusive environment. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance

title: Examensarbete: Lokalt driftsatta eller molntjänstbaserade språkmodeller – en break-even-analys
description:
**Övergripande beskrivning**
 Detta examensarbete syftar till att undersöka när det lönar sig för en organisation att köra en språkmodell med öppna vikter på egen infrastruktur, jämfört med att betala per token för en hanterad molntjänst. Hanterade tjänster har inga fasta kostnader och skalar efter behov. Egen drift innebär däremot en i stort sett fast kostnad som bara lönar sig när hårdvaran utnyttjas tillräckligt. De flesta jämförelser utgår från jämn belastning och jämför prislistor. Då döljs effekten av ojämn trafik i verkligheten, och det tas sällan hänsyn till att olika modeller kan ge olika kvalitet. Arbetet ska utforska vid vilken användningsnivå, och för vilka typer av arbetslaster, egen drift blir motiverad.
   

  

**Projektbeskrivning**
 Projektet kommer att innebära att jämföra två eller flera driftsalternativ för samma arbetslast, exempelvis en hanterad språkmodell via en molntjänst och en modell med öppna vikter som körs på GPU-instanser i molnet eller på egen hårdvara. Alternativen utvärderas på en eller två definierade uppgifter, exempelvis sammanfattning eller frågor och svar kring dokument. Testerna drivs med realistisk och ojämn trafik, exempelvis genom att spela upp publikt tillgängliga användningsloggar. Studenten har stort utrymme att själv välja modeller, uppgifter, metoder och avgränsningar.
   

  

 Forskningen kommer att fokusera på att mäta kostnad, latens, genomströmning och kvalitet på svaren, och att utifrån resultaten ta fram en kostnadsmodell som visar var break-even-punkten ligger beroende på utnyttjandegrad och trafikmönster. Kostnadsmodellen kombineras med faktorer som inte rör kostnad, exempelvis dataskydd, regelefterlevnad och driftsinsats, till ett ramverk som kan stödja beslut. Eftersom priser och modeller förändras snabbt ska metoden och kostnadsmodellen vara återanvändbara, så att de kan uppdateras över tid.
   

  

**Vem söker vi?**
* Masterutbildning inom datateknik, datavetenskap, teknisk fysik eller närliggande område
* Inriktning mot maskininlärning, molnbaserad utveckling eller prestandautvärdering är meriterande
* Examen i juni 2027
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
* Flytande engelska i tal och skrift


**Syfte**
 Syftet med examensarbetet är att skapa en djupare förståelse för hur kostnad, prestanda och kvalitet förhåller sig till varandra när språkmodeller körs i egen regi jämfört med via hanterade molntjänster. Arbetet förväntas resultera i en reproducerbar jämförelse, en återanvändbar kostnadsmodell och ett beslutsramverk. Resultatet kan ge organisationer bättre underlag för att avgöra när det är rimligt att köra språkmodeller själva och när hanterade tjänster är att föredra.
   

  

**En spännande resa med Knightec Group**
 Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det?
   

  

 Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling.
   

  

 På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt.
   

  

**Praktisk information**
 Detta är en masteruppsats-tjänst med placering på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Startdatum är i januari 2027, exakta datum släpps närmre inpå.
   

  

 Det färdiga examensarbetet kan publiceras och användas både i din personliga portfölj och i företagets marknadsföring. Vänligen bifoga CV och personligt brev i din ansökan.
   

  

 Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-29. Om du har några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Hibatallah Belhajali på Hibatallah.belhajali@knightec.se. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

title: Product Developer Knitwear - H&M Womenswear
description:

*We are looking for a Product Developer with a strategic mindset, a strong passion for knitwear garments and a collaborative spirit to join our Womenswear team at H&M.*




*This position is based at our HQ in Stockholm, Sweden.*
  

  

  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 
**​**
  

 As a Product Developer within knitwear you will play a key role in shaping the H&M Womenswear assortment. You will set and drive both short and long‑term plans for your category, ensuring alignment with our overall assortment direction.
   

  





 With a strong commercial mindset, deep product knowledge within knitwear and the ability to translate trends into relevant opportunities, you will identify seasonal keys and act fast on what’s emerging. You will continuously refine our product and component work to build a strong, competitive and customer‑centred knitwear offer.

title: Senior RF Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Coherent is a global leader in photonics, developing advanced laser, optical and materials technologies that enable semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications and precision industrial applications worldwide.
   

  

 In Sweden, our teams operate the country’s only full-scale indium phosphide wafer fabrication facility. Here, we design, manufacture and test some of the world’s fastest optical chips under one roof, supporting AI infrastructure, data centres and global communications networks.
   

  

**The Role**
 You will be responsible for the RF evaluation and characterisation of high-speed optoelectronic and semiconductor components, working hands-on within our engineering test laboratory.
   

  

 This role combines RF measurement, device characterisation, test development and data analysis, giving you the opportunity to work closely with Product Verification, Design, Test Development and Manufacturing Engineering teams.
   

  

 You will also act as an RF technical expert within the laboratory, helping develop measurement capabilities, improve products and technologies, and share your expertise across the wider engineering organisation.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Perform hands-on RF measurements and device characterisation at wafer, chip and chip-on-carrier level.
* Lead the development, refinement and evaluation of RF measurement methods, procedures and engineering test setups.
* Design and implement dedicated RF test structures to extract device characteristics and support model development.
* Analyse measurement data, correlate practical results with simulations and provide structured technical feedback to Design teams.
* Specify, plan and coordinate test samples and prototype development in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.
* Act as an RF technical expert within the laboratory and maintain strong technical competence in RF and high-speed device characterisation.
* Develop clear technical documentation to support product development, engineering activities and knowledge transfer.
* Contribute to continuous product and technology improvements, including supporting production-related processes where required.
* Identify and promote new component technologies, measurement methodologies and engineering best practices.
* Mentor and support colleagues across Product Verification, Design and Test Development by sharing technical knowledge and expertise.


**About You**
 You are a hands-on RF engineer who enjoys working in the laboratory, developing measurement methods and using experimental data to understand and improve high-speed semiconductor and optoelectronic devices.
   

  

**You Will Ideally Bring**
* A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Physics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* At least 2 years of professional experience within optoelectronics, semiconductor devices, RF engineering, electrical engineering, engineering physics or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of RF measurements and high-speed optoelectronic or semiconductor device characterisation.
* Hands-on experience within an RF or optoelectronic test laboratory.
* Experience with test and measurement equipment, laboratory hardware and test automation for semiconductor device characterisation.
* Knowledge of data analysis, statistical analysis and Design of Experiments (DoE).
* The ability to correlate practical measurement results with theoretical simulations and modelling.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to share technical knowledge effectively.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to work across Engineering, Product Verification, Manufacturing Engineering and other technical functions.


 Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:
   

  

 🤝 Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust
   

  

 ✨ Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas
   

  

 🎯 Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome
   

  

 🌍 Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone
   

  

 🚀 Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

* A supportive, professional and international working environment.
* The opportunity to work within an innovation-driven company at the forefront of advanced photonics and semiconductor technology.
* Subsidised massage at the office.
* The possibility of quarterly or annual bonus programmes.
* A generous wellness allowance and access to health-promoting activities.


 Application & Selection
   

  

 We apply a continuous selection process, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, reference checks and alcohol and drug screening are conducted prior to employment.
   

  

 If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to kris.cairns@coherent.com. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.
   

  

**About Us**
 Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!
   

  

**Note to recruiters and employment agencies:** 
 We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
**Help shape the future of digital healthcare**
-----------------------------------------------

  

Dermicus is a telemedicine platform used by nurses, GPs and dermatologists to capture skin and wound images and get fast specialist input. We're a small team in Gothenburg and Stockholm, now part of Omda, a healthcare software company with more than 250 employees and customers in 27 countries.

  

We're hiring a Senior Mobile Engineer who combines strong technical skills with an interest in building intuitive user experiences. While engineering ownership is the core of the role, you'll also have the opportunity to influence how the product works and feels for clinicians. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, taking initiative, and driving work forward. You'll own the mobile experience, but you'll also be part of a team where everyone contributes across boundaries when needed.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own and lead the development of our React Native application for iOS and Android.
* Drive technical decisions and help define the long-term mobile strategy.
* Lead major product and platform improvements from idea to production.
* Work closely with product management, developers, QA, and clinical stakeholders.
* Solve complex technical problems and ensure high-quality, maintainable solutions.
* Support the team wherever needed, whether that's mobile, frontend, backend integrations, or platform improvements.
* Help improve architecture, development practices, and engineering standards.


We are a small team, which means ownership matters. There is no separate group that picks up difficult bugs, cleans up technical debt, or fixes things that fall between teams. We solve problems together.

**How we work**
---------------

  

AI coding tools are a natural part of how we build software. We expect you to be comfortable using tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar to accelerate development while maintaining strong engineering judgment.  

  

We build software used in healthcare, so documentation, quality, traceability, and validation are part of the job. We care about understanding why something works, not just that it works.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of experience building and shipping mobile applications.
* Strong React Native experience.
* Experience owning and leading mobile development, not just contributing to it.
* Proven ability to take initiatives from concept through delivery.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.
* Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for outcomes.
* Curious, self-driven, and motivated to continuously learn.
* Strong engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, documentation, and maintainable code.
* Professional working proficiency in English.
* An appreciation for good UI and UX, with the ability to contribute to product and user experience discussions when needed.


Above all, we're looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving difficult problems, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a small, high-performing team.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with mobile UX and UI design.
* Experience with backend development.
* Experience with modern web development and frontend frameworks.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, or platform engineering.
* Experience with native iOS and Android capabilities, particularly camera and media handling.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or life sciences.
* Swedish language skills.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Ownership of a product used daily by healthcare professionals.
* A small team with significant influence on product and technology decisions.
* The opportunity to shape the future of mobile within Dermicus.
* A flexible hybrid setup, with approximately two days per week in our Gothenburg office.
* The backing and stability of Omda, while maintaining the speed and autonomy of a focused product team.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer – Stockholm
description:
**Om uppdraget**
----------------

Vi söker en senior UX/UI Designer till ett produktteam som utvecklar digitala tjänster där data står i centrum. Användarna behöver snabbt kunna förstå vad informationen visar och vilka åtgärder som behöver vidtas.


Du får ansvar genom hela designprocessen, från research och problemförståelse till färdig design och validering. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med utvecklare, analytiker, verksamheten och organisationens designsystemteam.


Du blir även en del av ett större designcommunity med andra UX- och UI-designers där erfarenheter, arbetssätt och designprinciper delas och utvecklas gemensamt.

**Vi söker dig som**
--------------------

Du är en erfaren produktdesigner som är trygg med att ta ansvar för hela designprocessen. Du trivs med komplexa problem där lösningen inte är given från början och kan både utmana beställningar och förklara dina designbeslut för verksamhet och utveckling.


Du har särskilt god förståelse för hur datatunga och komplexa gränssnitt kan göras begripliga och användbara för professionella användare.

**Arbetsuppgifter ️**
---------------------

* Leda intervjuer, workshops och behovsinsamling med användare och verksamhet.
* Identifiera bakomliggande behov och utmana befintliga lösningar.
* Ta fram användarflöden, koncept och prototyper.
* Validera lösningar tillsammans med användare.
* Utforma dashboards, diagram och tabeller tillsammans med dataanalytiker.
* Göra komplex data begriplig och tydligt kopplad till användarens nästa handling.
* Bidra med komponenter för datavisualisering till organisationens designsystem.
* Strukturera och prioritera behov och krav tillsammans med produktteamet.
* Följa upp designlösningar efter lansering och bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar.

**Obligatoriska krav**
----------------------

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som produktdesigner eller motsvarande, med ansvar från research till färdigt gränssnitt.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att designa datatäta gränssnitt för professionella användare, exempelvis analysverktyg eller dashboards.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med och bidra till designsystem.
* Självständig erfarenhet av att planera och genomföra research och workshops.
* Mycket god vana av Figma.
* Flytande svenska och engelska.
* Portfolio med minst två relevanta case:


	+ minst ett case inom datavisualisering eller datatätt gränssnitt
	+ minst ett case som visar hela processen från research till färdig design.


Anonymiserade case är möjliga.

**Meriterande krav**
--------------------

* Kunskap om principer för datavisualisering, inklusive tillgängliga diagram enligt WCAG 2.2.
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt välja vilken typ av data som ska visas och avgöra vilken information som är viktigast för användaren.
* Erfarenhet av gränssnitt med många olika tillstånd.
* Erfarenhet av att vidareutveckla verktyg som användarna är beroende av i sitt dagliga arbete.
* Erfarenhet av att balansera användarbehov mot affärsmål och mätbar effekt.
* Erfarenhet av AI-stöd genom hela designprocessen, från research till implementation.
* Erfarenhet från detaljhandel eller dagligvaruhandel.


I intervju ingår genomgång av ett eget case där du beskriver problem, research, vägval och effekt.

**Uppdragsinformation**
-----------------------

**Plats:** Stockholm  

**Omfattning:** 100 %, cirka 40 timmar per vecka  

**Period:** 3 november 2026 – 30 juni 2027  

**Distansarbete:** 0 %, arbetet utförs på plats  

**Senioritetsnivå:** Senior  

**Möjlighet till förlängning finns.**


Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.


Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd.
