title: Solution Architect - Infrastructure Data Center Transformation , Presales - Stockholm, Amsterdam, London, Frankfurt
description:
**Role: Infrastructure Data Center Transformation Solution Architect / Presales**
**Role Designation: Principal Consultant**
**Career Stream: Pre-sales / Solutions**
**Career SubStream: Technical, Techno commercial**
**Location – Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Germany, London (Any EMEA location)**
 As a Solution Architect focused on Infrastructure Data Center Transformation Solutions / Presales, the role owns the creation of strong, differentiated and commercially viable infrastructure solutions across data center modernization, private and hybrid cloud, virtualization, HPC, CaaS, Infra for AI, AI POD and AI Factory-led transformation. The role plays the technical architect and integrated solution owner across pursuits, translating Infosys capabilities into client-ready solution constructs and vendor/client price book patterns while bringing together Data center, Network, Cyber, Cloud and MS threads into one coherent end-to-end proposal. The role is expected to combine deep technical architecture skills with strong techno-commercial judgment, partner ecosystem understanding, solution pricing awareness, and AI-led differentiation to shape winning solutions in compliance with Infosys guidelines, policies and norms.
   

  

**Additional Requirements**
 Demonstrated experience in Infrastructure Data Center Transformation, Solution Architecture and Presales, with expertise across Data Center, Private and Hybrid Cloud, Network, Cyber, Managed Services, ITSM, automation and AI-enabled infrastructure solutions. The role must have at least one primary and one secondary area of specialization, with the ability to design integrated, multi-tower solutions and translate technical solution components into vendor and client pricing constructs, bill of materials, assumptions, commercials and price book patterns.
   

  

**Areas of Responsibility**
* Business Planning


 Performs the analysis of services, products and technologies under guidance to provide input on the service offering and input on suitable customers for pursuits.
   

  

* Marketing & Branding


 Evangelizes Infosys Tech Brand in specific areas (e.g., anchoring Tech Day, white papers, speaking in forums, etc.); Builds artifacts in new areas of competency to build collateral and Go-To-Market solutions.
   

  

* Prospecting


 Identifies opportunities in accounts or new technology areas and provides necessary credentials to support the Client Services team in prospecting.
   

  

* Proposals


 Leads infrastructure transformation proposals as the solution architect and integrated solution owner; writes strong, differentiated solution responses, owns the solution storyline, validates solution fitment, and brings together Data center, Network, Cyber, Cloud and MS workstreams into a single coherent pursuit. Provides domain technical consultation to Pre-Sales, participates in proposal discussions, client workshops and solution reviews, architects and validates complex technical solutions, performs estimations and price book mapping, and brings alliance offerings, Infosys IP and AI-led differentiators into the solution.
   

  

* Alliance


 Interacts with vendors and alliances to understand complementary offerings, products, IP, reference architectures, sizing models and commercial constructs. Translates Infosys solution requirements into vendor bill of material and pricing patterns, and converts vendor constructs back into client-facing solution and price book structures with clear assumptions, dependencies and value differentiation.
   

  

* Contracting & Agreement


 Provides technical and techno-commercial inputs for contracting and deal negotiations, including solution assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, SLAs, service outcomes, transition approach, tooling, AI automation commitments, partner dependencies and pricing guardrails in consulting and managed services contractual documents.
   

  

* Project Scoping


 Organizes, documents, and reviews work items' scope from a technical viewpoint and approach to ensure completeness and consistency in scoping of the project.
   

  

* Estimation


 Reviews and validates estimates for consulting projects and guides estimation for complex projects IN ORDER TO ensure correct sizing of the work.
   

  

* Resource Planning


 Provides and reviews inputs on various competencies important for forming teams for projects to address resource competency requirements for the project.
   

  

* Scheduling


 Provides consulting inputs/insight into the complexity of architectural requirements; Reviews work breakdown structure & resources/task/activity planning, sets milestones and deliverables to ensure correctness and optimal scheduling of the project.
   

  

* Quality Planning


 Reviews and validates the target metrics of a project from a technology perspective like tools usage, reusable frameworks, and feasibility to assist in achieving the quality target.
   

  

* Risk Planning


 Reviews, identifies, and prioritizes technical risks to develop a risk mitigation plan.
   

  

* Project Plan Review


 Participates in project plan reviews and provides inputs to ensure accuracy of the plan.
   

  

* Problem Definition


 Participates in customer discussions in various stages of the consulting engagement to understand the problems faced by the customer and articulates the same to the internal stakeholders; Defines and documents the problem and gets customer agreement. Brings in best practices in the industry to in identifying and defining the problem.
   

  

* Requirements Gathering


 Ensures and reviews that the business/technical requirements are understood and translated to system requirements (product requirements) consistent with frameworks/standards to meet requirements definition for products and large projects.
   

  

* Diagnostic Discovery/As-Is Assessment


 Participates in or Conducts workshops to understand the As-Is process/system study and identify high-level process/system changes to arrive at proposed requirements, process maps, fit-gap analysis, and requirements/assessment documents that are agreeable to the customer.
   

  

* Solution Evaluation and Recommendation


 Provides inputs to the customer solution roadmap as the SME in the domain with possible solution alternatives that factor in gap realization, impact on related functional/technical areas, feasibility, and efficiency to assist in arriving at the final solution definition.
   

  

* Strategy & Road Map Definition


 Performs As-Is analysis and provides To-Be recommendations, evaluates product technology solutions, and provides solutions to specialized problems to provide inputs on the technical and domain road map.
   

  

* Architecture


 Acts as the technical architect for pursuits and transformation engagements; creates, consults and reviews architecture decisions across compute, storage, network, cyber, cloud, managed services, virtualization, HPC, CaaS and AI infrastructure domains. Produces solution blueprints, reference architectures and migration patterns that embed AI-led operations, automation, observability, resiliency and FinOps/commercial optimization.
   

  

* Design and Product/Solution Development


 Evaluates and reviews design frameworks, methodologies and solution building blocks, and owns the integrated solution design across towers. Ensures functional and non-functional alignment, commercial feasibility, technology fitment, partner alignment, AI-enabled automation opportunities and clear mapping of Infosys solution components to client-consumable value propositions and pricing structures.
   

  

* Development/Build


 Conducts NFR (non-functional requirement) compliance verifications; validates NFR compliance; ensures alignment with overall architecture view; creates/develops reference codes. Provides consultation to TLs (Team Leads) on complex coding and technical/product issues to ensure effective solution development.
   

  

* Testing


 Provides consultation to TLs on test strategy and solutions, develops test strategy for complex testing requirements, and sets complex multi-vendor, multi-platform testing environments to achieve effective validation.
   

  

* Implementation


 Validates/reviews large/complex deployment solutions & frameworks and creates the blueprint for large deployment solutions IN ORDER TO meet technical challenges in deployment.
   

  

* Knowledge Management


 Evangelizes the usage of reusable frameworks and artifacts, creates knowledge/certification artifacts and evaluation criteria, and guides or provides technical training in relevant technology areas to develop talent in technology/domain.
   

  

* Post Implementation Support


 Resolves critical issues coming at live sites; identifies and fixes critical architectural/framework issues related to the product to meet SLA (Service Level Agreement) requirements during warranty.
   

  

* People Management


 Creates knowledge/certification artifacts and evaluation criteria, mentors in building new areas of competency, guides or provides technical training in relevant technology areas, assists in employees' career planning, and conducts technical interviews to develop talent in technology/domain.
   

  

* Financial Management


 Understands infrastructure transformation pricing models, vendor commercials, license/subscription constructs, consumption patterns, unit pricing, managed services cost drivers and price book structures. Supports solution-level revenue, margin and profitability analysis, validates commercial assumptions, and ensures technical choices are aligned with deal economics and client value outcomes.
   

  

* Client Management


 Leads technical and techno-commercial discussions with customer SMEs, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders and procurement stakeholders. Articulates Infosys technical differentiation, AI-led transformation value, solution trade-offs, pricing rationale and delivery confidence in a way that supports pursuit progression and client decision-making.
   

  

* Unit/Org Activities


 Assists in the creation of solutions and other IP artifacts, evangelizes the Infosys Tech Brand in specific areas (e.g., anchoring Tech Day, white papers, speaking in forums) to strengthen competency/expertise in technology/domain.). Consulting Practice development
   

  

**Areas Of Responsibility – Additional Requirements**
 Broad-based knowledge of infrastructure platforms, partner products, reference architectures and commercial models across data center transformation, private/hybrid cloud, network, cyber, managed services and AI-enabled infrastructure domains.
   

  

* Ability to define complex, AI-enabled infrastructure architectures and anchor solution reviews across data center, cloud, network, cyber and managed services towers.
* Strong appreciation of consulting, presales, solutioning and pricing frameworks, including assumptions, dependency mapping, effort models, vendor bill of material and client price book alignment.
* Strong customer, vendor, alliance and internal stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead pursuits and integrate inputs from Data center, Network, Cyber, Cloud and MS teams.
* Ability to leverage domain knowledge and AI-first solution thinking to solve business and IT problems from a technology, operating model and commercial perspective, while switching context across multiple infrastructure services.
* Contribute to thought leadership participate in calls relationship with analysts in her/his focus areas
* Identify and create printable artifacts guides and author papers
* Help seniors in appraisals of juniors and career aspiration program and maintaining of technical discussions with customer technology experts to provide technical differentiation.


**Must-Have Skills / Key Competencies**
* Pre-Sales & Solution Leadership: Proven expertise in pre-sales, infrastructure transformation architecture, and leading large-scale deals within the Data Center Transformation domain, including end-to-end solution design spanning DC network, security, and platform services.
* Cross-Industry Transformation Experience: Extensive experience in delivering data center infrastructure transformation and consulting across multiple industry verticals, enabling well-rounded, cross-domain solutioning.
* Enterprise & Cross-Domain Architecture: Strong enterprise architecture capabilities with a deep understanding of multi-technology integration across infrastructure layers, ensuring cohesive and future-ready solutions.
* Techno-Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to balance technical excellence with commercial viability, shaping competitive and value-driven data center transformation solutions.
* Stakeholder Collaboration & Transformation Consulting: Strong consulting mindset with proven ability to engage client stakeholders and internal teams, ensuring seamless integration during transformation and consolidation programs.
* Communication & Expectation Management: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on stakeholder alignment, transparency, and effective expectation management throughout the transformation lifecycle.
* Partner solution: Leverage partnerships with HPE, Dell, Equinix and other DC providers, Hitachi, Veeam, Commvault, NVIDIA and relevant cloud, virtualization, AI infrastructure and cyber ecosystem partners to bring best-in-class solutions. The role must be able to map partner technologies into Infosys-led AI-enabled propositions, including optimized hardware, GPU and accelerated compute, hybrid cloud options, AI-ready storage, data protection, resiliency, automation and managed services constructs. Partner lists are subject to change.


**About Infosys**
 Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 59 countries to navigate their digital transformation.
   

  

 With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer clients, in 59 countries, as they navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and AI. We enable them with an AI-first core, empower the business with agile digital at scale and drive continuous improvement with always-on learning through the transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. We are deeply committed to being a well-governed, environmentally sustainable organization where diverse talent thrives in an inclusive workplace.
   

  

**All aspects of employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**

 Vi söker nu en erfaren DevOps Engineer med stark kompetens inom CI/CD som vill arbeta i tekniskt avancerade projekt inom försvarsindustrin. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av säkerhetskritiska system som ställer höga krav på kvalitet, robusthet och informationssäkerhet.

* Erfarenhet av Git, GitLab, GitHub eller liknande plattformar

title: Applied AI Analyst
description:
We want to create a different kind of banking and shopping experience. Northmill was founded in 2006 and the main office is in Stockholm and Engineering Center site located in Poland.
   

  

 Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!
   

  

**The Scope Of Your Role**
 As an Applied AI Analyst, you will work across business departments and product engineering teams to discover, analyse and validate high-value opportunities for process automation.
   

  

 This role combines business and process analysis with hands-on AI prototyping and a solid understanding of software engineering. You will work directly with process owners and operational teams to understand how work is performed today, identify bottlenecks and repetitive activities, assess the potential value of improvements, and turn the most promising opportunities into testable AI-enabled solutions.
   

  

 You will actively search for opportunities rather than wait for predefined requirements. Once an idea is validated, you will work with Product Engineers and the AI Platform team to shape the production approach and transfer ownership to the relevant product team.
   

  

**You Will Be Responsible For**
* Working with process owners and business teams to understand and map existing processes
* Identifying bottlenecks, manual work and opportunities for AI-assisted or automated workflows
* Translating business problems into clear use cases, requirements and testable hypotheses
* Assessing business value, feasibility, data readiness, operational risk and required controls
* Building and validating lightweight prototypes, independently or together with engineering teams
* Defining success metrics, acceptance criteria and evaluation scenarios
* Recommending whether a process should be assisted, partially automated or fully automated
* Supporting Product Engineers in moving validated solutions toward production
* Embedding with product teams when needed to support implementation, adoption and knowledge transfer
* Sharing reusable patterns and providing feedback to the AI Platform Team


**You Will Work With**
* Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick and other foundation-model platforms
* Agentic workflows and tool-based integrations
* Company data, documents and internal systems
* REST APIs and event-driven integrations
* .NET, C# and TypeScript
* Modern AI development and prototyping tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot


**Required Qualifications**
* 5+ years of commercial experience in software engineering, business analysis, process automation, AI engineering or a related role
* Strong ability to analyse, map and improve business processes
* Experience working directly with process owners, operational teams and business stakeholders
* Ability to turn unclear business problems into structured use cases, requirements and experiments
* Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI-enabled prototypes or automation workflows
* Strong product mindset and focus on measurable business outcomes
* Solid understanding of software engineering, APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of AI security, privacy and operational risks
* Swedish proficiency at C1/C2 level
* English proficiency at B2/C1 level or higher


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick or similar services
* Experience with process mining, workflow engines or business-process redesign
* Experience with agent tools, MCP or AI-enabled integrations
* Experience with document extraction, classification or knowledge-based AI solutions
* Experience supporting a solution from discovery through production handover
* Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry


**About you?**
 You’re a curious and business-minded AI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine passion for artificial intelligence, translating business needs into innovative, data-driven solutions.
   

  

 You’re comfortable sharing your thoughts, raising problems early, and contributing to thoughtful solutions. You thrive in a team environment and have experience working in an Agile setup.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views.
* An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact.
* Great opportunities for professional development.
* Support for sporting activities (a SEK 5,000 wellness allowance).
* Life insurance.
* Breakfast and fruit in the office every day, plus a Friday afternoon coffee break.
* Regular after-work get-togethers on Fridays and celebrations of successes in the office.


**About Northmill Bank**
 A Swedish bank with the heart in the technique. 2.500 merchants. 600.000 end users.
   

  

 over 300 employees in 3 different countries, including Engineering Center hiring c.a. 90 experienced engineers. The goal? To improve financial life by being digital, yet personal.
   

  

**Apply today and be a part of Northmill!**
 Northmill Bank is a tech company with a banking license aiming to improve financial life, offer merchants smart solutions and erase the borders between in-store and online.
   

  

 Northmill creates a more personal and relevant experience for people and companies, helping more than 2,500 merchants and 250,000 end users.
   

  

**Trustpilot** 
 4.5 of 5
   

  

**Cloud** 
 100 %
   

  

**End users** 
 250 000

title: Principal AI/ML Engineer
description:
**Craft:**
 Data, Analytics & Strategy
   

  

**Job Description:**
****Principal AI/ML Engineer – Decision Automation****
****Candy Crush Saga | King****
 Are you motivated by building the shared decisioning foundations for how a live game learns, experiments, and adapts at scale?
   

  

 Join King as a
 **Principal AI/ML Engineer** 
 in the
 **Decision Automation** 
 team for
 **Candy Crush Saga** 
 . In this role, you will help turn fragmented AI/ML and decisioning approaches into scalable, production-grade systems that support faster experimentation, safer adaptation, and more coherent player experiences across the game.
   

  

 This is a
 **hands-on senior technical leadership role** 
**.** 
 You will shape direction through architecture, code, prototyping, design reviews, and deep technical judgment. We are not looking for a strategy-only leader. We are looking for someone who can build, simplify, and connect complex systems across team boundaries.
   

  

****The Role****
 You’ll join the
 **Decision Automation** 
 team within Candy Crush Saga: a cross-functional AI/ML team working closely with product, analytics, engineering, game teams, and central platform partners to enable faster, smarter, and more player-centric decisions across the game.
   

  

 Our mission is to accelerate Candy’s learning loop by automating insight generation, experimentation, and adaptation at scale. This role is central to helping define and build the shared architecture needed to make decision automation more scalable, reliable, and reusable across Candy.
   

  

****The team works across areas such as:****
* Causal inference and simulation capabilities usable by product teams
* Generalized automated decisioning systems across multiple game features
* Orchestration across ML systems to reduce conflicting treatments and coordination overhead


 With hundreds of millions of players, the systems you help shape will operate at significant scale and influence core player-facing decisions across Candy Crush Saga.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Influence technical direction across Candy Crush Saga in AI/ML and decisioning through credibility, clarity, and delivery
* Stay hands-on through meaningful production coding, technical prototyping, and implementation work on critical paths
* Set a high bar for production AI/ML engineering, including reliability, observability, maintainability, and quality of execution
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the standard of technical judgment, design quality, and cross-team collaboration
* Lead the shared architecture for AI/ML and automated decisioning systems used across multiple components in Candy Crush Saga
* Help unify fragmented approaches into reusable technical foundations that improve consistency, speed, and scalability
* Partner with product and game teams to turn high-value opportunities into reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions


****What You Bring****
****Deep AI/ML Expertise****
* Deep experience building and shipping production AI/ML systems with meaningful business impact
* Strong applied expertise in areas such as personalization and causal inference
* Track record of connecting AI/ML methodology with real production guardrails, constraints and operational use


****Technical Leadership****
* Proven ability to influence technical direction across teams through credibility, clarity, and execution
* Experience defining shared patterns, technical standards, or architectural direction in complex environments
* Ability to lead senior-level technical discussions with substance and precision


****Communication and Collaboration****
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Proven ability to influence across departments and align teams around shared technical direction
* Strong mentoring capability, especially with senior engineers and technical leaders
* Comfortable representing technical work in high-visibility forums, internally and externally


****Product and Cross-Functional Collaboration****
* Able to shape product bets through technical insight and co-create reusable capabilities with cross-functional partners
* Effective working across engineering, analytics, product, and platform teams
* Strong judgment in translating business goals into scalable technical systems


****Nice to Have****
* Experience with large-scale experimentation platforms, personalization systems, or decisioning infrastructure
* Familiarity with game technology, player-facing optimization, or content adaptation systems
* Experience reducing fragmented or bespoke ML workflows into shared technical foundations


**Locations:**
* Stockholm, Barcelona and London


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Strategisk produktledare till Arbetsförmedlingen
description:
*Inom myndigheten arbetar vi för mer standardiserade verksamhetsprocesser och IT-lösningar. Här finns stora möjligheter att bidra till och påverka utvecklingen. Vi arbetar i tvärfunktionella produktteam och ansvarar för en bredd av tekniska lösningar, från egenutvecklade lösningar till standardsystem.*




*Produktområdet IT Ekonomi & Inköp vidareutvecklar både sina arbetssätt och sitt tekniska landskap. Målet är att med rätt IT-lösningar skapa goda förutsättningar för effektiva verksamhetsprocesser. Tillsammans får vi Sverige i arbete. Vill du bli en av oss?*




****Beskrivning av tjänsten****




 Vi söker en erfaren strategisk produktledare inom IT som vill utveckla och leda en produktorganisation i en komplex verksamhet. Du kan skapa riktning och framdrift även när förutsättningarna förändras och alla svar ännu inte är givna. Du har arbetat i leveransledande roller i stora, komplexa organisationer där förändringsledning varit en viktig del av arbetet.
   

  





 Du har gedigen kunskap om ekonomi- eller inköpsprocesser och tillhörande tekniska standardlösningar. Du har erfarenhet av att införa eller byta IT-lösningar och kunskap om andra delar av deras livscykel, från upphandling till avveckling.
   

  





 Du kan omsätta verksamhetens långsiktiga mål till riktning, prioriteringar och konkreta initiativ. Du skapar förutsättningar för att våra IT-lösningar utvecklas och förvaltas med hög kvalitet, kostnadseffektivitet och långsiktighet.
   

  





 I rollen behöver du kunna tänka strategiskt och omsätta planer i handling. Du leder genom andra, skapar samsyn mellan verksamhet och IT och driver utveckling där behov, teknik, ekonomi och regelverk behöver vägas samman.
   

  





****Vårt erbjudande****




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsorten är Solna.
   

  





 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Du får tillgång till ett generöst semesteravtal, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis. Hos oss ingår även friskvård under arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag. Mer om att jobba hos oss 
   

  





****Grundläggande krav för tjänsten****



* Gedigen kunskap om inköps- eller ekonomiprocesser ur både verksamhets- och IT-perspektiv.
* Minst fem års aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av ERP-system inom inköp eller ekonomi i större organisationer.
* Erfarenhet av minst 2 systemimplementationer kopplade till inköp eller ekonomi i större organisationer.
* Minst åtta års aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av strategisk produktledning eller motsvarande ledande IT-roller i stora organisationer med tvärfunktionella team. I rollerna ska du ha ansvarat för att omsätta verksamhetens mål till produktvisioner och konkreta färdplaner.



****Övriga meriter för tjänsten****



* Erfarenhet av tekniska lösningars hela livscykel, från förstudie och upphandling till implementation, förvaltning och avveckling.
* Bred erfarenhet av att tillämpa arbetssätt och metoder för IT-leveranser, exempelvis produktorganisationer, skalat agilt arbetssätt, ITIL och pm³.
* Minst tre års erfarenhet av förändringsledning med fokus på ökad leveransprecision och tydlighet i komplexa organisationer.
* Minst tre års erfarenhet av att skapa stabilitet och struktur i otydliga eller snabbt föränderliga miljöer.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera med olika målgrupper.



  
   

  





 Den statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.  
   

  





 Utöver detta har du personlig förmåga och fallenhet att arbeta i enlighet med Arbetsförmedlingens medarbetarkriterier. Läs mer om den statliga värdegrunden och våra medarbetarkriterier på vår hemsida.  Som medarbetare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:
   

  





**Ansvarstagande** 
 – ta ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.
   

  





**Handlingskraftig** 
 – ta initiativ, bidra till förbättringar och hantera förändringar.
   

  





**Resultatfokuserad** 
 – planera, följa upp och bidra till verksamhetsnytta och resultat.
   

  





****Ansökan****




 Låter det här som en tjänst för dig? Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-18.
   

  





 Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning.
   

  





 Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.
   

  





 Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess. 
   

  





 Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.
   

  





 Välkommen till oss – vi jobbar för ett Sverige i arbete! Här arbetar du på regeringens uppdrag för en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad. Målet är att korta tiden i arbetslöshet genom att matcha arbetssökande med arbetsgivare. Våra insatser riktas i första hand till dem som står längst ifrån arbetsmarknaden och till de arbetsgivare som är öppna för att anställa dem med störst behov av stöd. Vi motverkar felaktiga utbetalningar och brott mot välfärdssystemen så att våra skattemedel används effektivt till det de är till för. Vi samarbetar med många andra aktörer och tillsammans hittar vi lösningar som gör skillnad - för ett Sverige i arbete.

title: Engineering Director
description:
RLDatix is on a mission to transform care delivery worldwide, ensuring every patient receives the safest, highest-quality care. Through our innovative Healthcare Operations Platform, we're connecting data to unlock trusted insights that enable improved decision-making and help deliver safer healthcare for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
 RLDatix (RLD) is on a mission to help raise the standard of care…everywhere. Trusted by over 10,000 healthcare organisations around the world, our solutions help improve health and care. Our applications ensure that patients receive the best and safest care while supporting the providers who deliver it.
   

  

 Joining TeamRLD means being part of a global effort of over 2,000 team members in making a difference in healthcare…every day.
   

  

 We're searching for a Stockholm-based Director, Engineering to join our TimeCare team, so that we can advance a market-leading workforce-scheduling platform used across the Nordics on its multi-year journey toward a cloud-native, AI-enabled future. The Director, Engineering will lead and coordinate the engineering teams responsible for the TimeCare product family (Planning, Pool, Integration, AutoRoster, Staff Mobile) across multiple technical domains to deliver integrated solutions that align with strategic business goals and help deliver safer, better healthcare for all.
   

  

**How You'll Spend Your Time**
* Guide the development of an integrated engineering strategy across the TimeCare product family to align product-line objectives with the broader RLDatix workforce-management strategy
* Own the multi-year modernisation trajectory in order to retire long-lived legacy surfaces, consolidate duplicated capabilities, and expand the modern cloud-native footprint on a defensible, customer-safe schedule
* Structure technical problem-solving frameworks and coordinate incident response to maintain system reliability across a large multi-tenant customer base
* Own the TimeCare AI agenda end-to-end, applying AI across the product, engineering workflow, and operations in order to raise throughput while maintaining quality and responsible-AI governance
* Mentor and develop engineering talent across multiple disciplines to foster technical excellence, career growth, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and psychological safety


**What Kind of Things We're Most Interested in You Having**
* 8+ years leading software engineering organisations, including at least 3 years managing managers, and experience leading engineering groups of 20 to 50 engineers across multiple teams and disciplines
* Proven success introducing AI capabilities into engineering practice and/or into a live product, with clear results and defensible governance
* In-depth knowledge on how to run multi-tenant SaaS at scale in a major public cloud, with infrastructure-as-code, automated deployment tooling, CI/CD, and mature observability practices
* Ability to commute to Stockholm on a hybrid basis, with periodic travel to other RLDatix engineering hubs and key customers
* Sincere interest in delivering enterprise software in regulated environments, with working knowledge of GDPR and awareness of the EU AI Act
* A knack for working collaboratively within a globally distributed, cross-functional environment spanning Product, Architecture, Security, and Customer Success


 By enabling flexibility in how we work and prioritising employee well-being, we empower our team to do and be their best.At RLDatix, we believe diverse perspectives help us build better solutions and stronger teams.
   

  

 We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to contribute fully. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, gender identity or expression, ethnicity, religion or other belief, disability, sexual orientation, age, or any other characteristic protected under Swedish law.
   

  

 As part of RLDatix's commitment to the inclusion of all qualified individuals, we provide reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require any adjustments to participate in the application or interview stages, please send a note to accessibility@rldatix.com

title: System Specialist (MBB RAN)
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
   

  

**Your role**
 As a
 **MBB RAN System specialist** 
 , you shall have deep expertise in 4G LTE and 5G NR radio networks, mobility management, and network optimisation. The successful candidate will play a key role in designing, analysing, and optimising coverage, mobility, handover performance, and roaming strategies across complex multi-operator and mission-critical network environments.
   

  

 The role requires strong technical knowledge of RAN architecture, mobility procedures, network sharing models (MOCN/MORAN), and radio performance optimisation to ensure exceptional user experience, service continuity, and network reliability and strong understanding of QoS/QCI.
   

  

**In this role you will play a key role in:**
* Design, optimize and troubleshoot LTE/NR Radio access network. Develop and implement coverage and capacity improvement strategies.
* Lead the design and optimisation of mobility management strategies across LTE and 5G networks covering Intra-Inter, LTE-NR, Inter RAT mobility, X2, XN interfaces in depth understanding, able to assess and support troubleshooting of issues in RAN coverage, capacity, and handover reliability
* Hands on experience in MOCN, MORAN, Roaming environments in CSP or mission critical networks. Deep understanding of SINR, RSRP, RSRQ, EN-DC, mobility triggers and procedures, etc.
* Understanding of RAN e/gNB IP stack routing and binding to IPSec/encryption tunnels in combination with MOCN. Strong understanding of QoS for LTE/NR (QCI/5QI priorities, scheduling, etc) and closely with core network teams to optimise signalling and mobility procedures
* Identify root causes of mobility-related service degradation and implement corrective actions, working closely with vendors and stakeholders to rectify the issues on priority. Prepare optimisation recommendations, test reports & design documentation


**Your profile**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, or related field
* Minimum 10 years of experience in LTE/NR, network optimisation, MOCN, MORAN
* Strong understanding of RF related tools like Atoll, TEMS, NEMO or equivalent
* Ability to bridge operational, architectural, and governance aspects of network optimization etc
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluency in English; Swedish language skills are advantageous


**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**
* Working with cutting-edge telecom technologies, including 5G Core and cloud-native architectures
* Opportunities to work on projects that deliver mission-critical services that are fundamental to the public safety of society and other critical national infrastructure
* Opportunities to contribute to large-scale transformation projects for leading telecom clients
* Being part of a collaborative, international, and highly skilled team
* Continuous learning opportunities and strong career development support


**Application**
**This role requires EU citizenship and is subject to security classification, meaning that a security screening will be carried out in accordance with Swedish legislation.**
 As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate, and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.
   

  

 Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Build the AI that runs the Nordics’ biggest entertainment group
description:
***We don’t need another slide about AI. We need someone to ship it.***
 Viaplay Group entertains millions every day – across streaming, sport, film, series, radio and TV. Behind that sits one of the deepest content libraries in the region: thousands of hours of sport and non-sport, millions of viewers, and a product touched by people every single evening.
   

  

 That scale is the opportunity. Every recommendation, every search, every onboarding flow, every workflow behind the scenes – all of it can be made smarter, faster and more personal with AI. We’re building an AI hub in Stockholm to make that happen, and we’re looking for the people who will actually build it.
   

  

**If you’ve been doing this in a startup – real AI work, limited budget, no safety net – imagine what you’d do with a giant audience, a mountain of content and a product that reaches the whole Nordics. This is that stage.**
**What You’ll Actually Do**
* Ship AI into the product customers touch – discovery, personalisation, search and the experiences that turn a browse into a play.
* Turn our content advantage into a product advantage: use sport and non-sport at scale to build things nobody else in the region can.
* Rip friction out of how we work – automate the repetitive, wire up agents and tools, and make teams dramatically faster.
* Prototype in days, not quarters. Prove it with real users. Then scale what works and kill what doesn’t.


**Who We’re Looking For**
 We care about what you’ve built, not the boxes you tick. You probably recognise yourself here:
   

  

* You build. You’ve shipped real AI – agents, models, tools – that solved an actual problem, not a demo.
* You move fast and think in outcomes. You’d rather have something live and learning than perfect on paper.
* You spot the opportunity in messy, complex systems and go straight for the highest-leverage fix.
* You challenge assumptions – including your own – and you don’t wait for permission to make things better.
* You bring people with you and create momentum when things are still undefined.
* You communicate clearly in English and can turn “technically possible” into something the whole business gets.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents for real business problems, or a background in software, product or digital transformation.


**How We Work**
 Substance over process. We’re a big company that wants to move like a small one – speed is our edge, and we protect it. You’ll have the reach of a big player in the markets and the freedom to actually make a difference. Show up, build, and let the work speak.
   

  

**What You Get**
* A rare canvas: massive audience, huge content library, and real ownership of what you ship.
* 30 days paid vacation, strong pension and insurance, and generous parental leave top-up.
* Wellbeing support including a wellness allowance, and a learning culture that puts you in the driver’s seat.
* Unlimited Viaplay – series, live events, new-release rentals, linear channels and more. Know the product you’re building for.


**Hit play**
 If this is your kind of challenge, apply with your CV (add your LinkedIn or GitHub while you’re at it). Applications by email can’t be accepted – but questions about the role are always welcome.
   

  

**Don’t send us a cover letter about AI. Tell us what you’ve built – and what you’d build here.**
 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Product Manager, Ecosystem Integration
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for an Product Manager, Ecosystem Integration!** 




**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden preferred or EU Remote
 



**Job ID: 48207** 




  





 We are seeking an Ecosystem Strategy and Portfolio Manager to define and drive the evolution of HID reader platforms to connect, align, and integrate across these environments. This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Sales, Platform Architecture, and Engineering, with strong exposure to external partners and ecosystem stakeholders.
 



 HID’s IDT Reader Business Unit is consolidating multiple legacy portfolios into a unified platform strategy across embedded modules, desktop readers, mobile devices, and associated software and cloud services.
 



  





 As this portfolio evolves, ensuring seamless interoperability across both internal platforms and the broader identity ecosystem is critical.
 



 This includes defining and driving how Reader BU platforms are aligned with and integrate seamlessly into adjacent systems such as credentials, controllers, authentication providers, and partner platforms, working closely with other Business Units, and Global Engineering teams to align requirements, architectures, and integration models.
 



  





 The position requires a combination of industry understanding, business planning, technical depth, strategic thinking, and cross-functional influence to federate multiple product lines into a consistent and scalable integration model. It plays a key role in driving platform convergence by ensuring integration, reuse, and ecosystem requirements are built into future platform architectures from the outset. The objective is to ensure HID platforms are easy to integrate, consistent to deploy, and built on shared, scalable foundations.
 



  





**Who are we?** 




 HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.
 



 We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
 



  





**Identification Technologies (IDT):** 




 IDT is creating trusted identities for IoT applications through Smart Components and Enabling Services.
 



 HID’s Identification Technologies powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things through smart components and cloud services. We make it possible for people and organizations to transact safely, work productively, and travel freely. Our contactless identification and sensing (RFID, NFC, and BLE) components and solution enabling technologies address the dynamic requirements across multiple industries to wirelessly connect, identify, collect and manage data quickly and accurately across virtually any IoT application.
 



  





**Essential Duties :** 



* Define and drive how Reader BU platforms are aligned with and integrate into internal systems and adjacent ecosystems.
* Develop business cases for new platform or integration investments.
* Influence future platform definitions by ensuring integration, interoperability, reuse, and ecosystem requirements are built in from the outset.
* Align product managers, platform architects, and engineering teams around common integration principles, standards, and priorities.
* Work closely with Global Engineering leadership to align on architectural decisions, integration frameworks, and platform priorities.
* Define cross-platform requirements early to prevent fragmentation and ensure consistency across product lines.
* Define and drive shared cross-platform roadmap priorities to ensure reuse, consistency, and convergence across Reader BU platforms.
* Drive reuse of common components, services, and integration frameworks across platforms, reducing duplication and accelerating time to market.
* Work with close colleagues to establish a coherent model for how devices, firmware, SDKs, APIs, and cloud services interact across platforms.
* Ensure a consistent and scalable developer and integration experience across all reader platforms.
* Define how Reader BU platforms integrate with external ecosystems, partners, and enterprise architectures.
* Act as the central point of coordination for cross-product and cross-BU integration topics and dependencies.
* Define monetization strategies for integration capabilities, including APIs, services, and ecosystem participation.
* Contribute to relevant industry standards bodies and alliances to ensure alignment and interoperability of Reader BU platforms.
* Maintain a strong understanding of technology trends, competitive ecosystems, and evolving integration models.
* Gather customer, partner, and field feedback to identify integration gaps and prioritize improvements.
* Manage integration capabilities across their full lifecycle, from concept through delivery and continuous improvement.
* Support go-to-market activities with clear positioning, messaging, and enablement around integration capabilities.



  





**Essential Qualifications** 



* Experience in RFID, identification technologies, or adjacent domains.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field; equivalent experience considered.
* Strong experience in system integration, APIs, SDKs, or platform-based product environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise architectures, IoT ecosystems, and multi-product platform environments.
* Understanding of device security, credential management, secure elements, and authentication frameworks.
* Knowledge of PKI, key management, or IoT security models is a strong plus.
* Experience working with or contributing to industry standards and ecosystem alliances is preferred.
* Proven ability to influence across global, cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed technical levels.
* Experience working in agile development environments (SAFe is a plus).



  





**What we can offer you:** 



* Competitive salary and rewards package.
* Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance.
* A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture.
* Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential.
* To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds.



  





**Why apply?** 



* **Empowerment:** 
 You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* **Innovation:** 
 You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* **Integrity:** 
 You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.



  





 HID does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
 



  





 HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. title: Master Thesis: Code-Graph-Based Context for AI-Assisted Software Engineering in Radio Baseband L1
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 AI coding assistants and agent frameworks are increasingly used to support software development, answering architecture questions, aiding analysis and troubleshooting, and assisting with code changes. Their usefulness depends less on the underlying model than on the context they are given about the specific system they work on. For a large, long-lived codebase such as Ericsson's Radio Baseband L1, feeding a model raw source files, or relying on it to parse the code on demand, scales poorly: relevant details are missed, structural relationships stay implicit, and cost and latency grow.
   

  

 This thesis explores a code graph, a structured and queryable model of the source code where nodes represent code entities (functions, modules, components, interfaces, signals) and edges represent their relationships (calls, dependencies, communication, and execution order), as the foundation for building domain context that an AI system can query instead of reading everything. The work will survey the state of the art, design and implement a method for extracting context from real Radio Baseband L1 source code, and evaluate its effectiveness against alternative approaches.
   

  

 The results will provide evidence-based guidance on whether and how source-derived context should be built and maintained in an industrial domain, directly informing how Ericsson builds AI support for product development.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Study the background and state of the art on code representation for AI (code graphs, code property graphs, static analysis, structural indexing, and retrieval or embeddings over code).
* Analyse a bounded set of Radio Baseband L1 components to identify the code entities and relationships that matter for domain understanding, including execution order.
* Design and implement a method and prototype for extracting a code graph and building domain context from source.
* Define what "effective context" means and how to measure it, covering accuracy, coverage, freshness, and cost.
* Evaluate the code-graph approach against alternatives, such as live code parsing and text or embedding retrieval, on representative domain tasks.
* Draw conclusions and provide recommendations, including how to keep context fresh and consistent with a given code baseline.


**The skills you bring:**
* You are pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* You have a solid foundation in software architecture, data structures such as graphs, and ideally static analysis or compilers.
* You are comfortable working with Python. The domain code is largely C/C++.
* You are interested in program analysis, knowledge representation, and AI-assisted software engineering.
* You are analytical, systematic, and able to work independently on a complex problem.
* You can communicate technical findings clearly and draw practical conclusions from your evaluation.
* This thesis is suitable for 2 students and corresponds to 30 ECTS credits per student.

title: Master Thesis: Optimizing AI generated code's energy efficiency
description:

 GenAI-based coding assistants and autonomous coding agents, such as Codex- and Claude Code-like systems, are increasingly used for code generation, completion, refactoring, testing, debugging, and optimization. * a methodology for evaluating the greenness of GenAI-generated applications;

title: Projektledare inom telekom!
description:
**Är du en erfaren projektledare som vill leda komplexa projekt i en av de mest dynamiska och kritiska branscherna idag?** 
 I våra projekt inom telekommunikation går du i framkant när det gäller att revolutionera global uppkoppling.
   

  

 Telekommunikation är synonymt med innovation och att arbeta i den här branschen innebär att du kommer att exponeras för de senaste framstegen inom teknik, som 5G, IoT och mer. Inte nog med det, du kommer leda och medverka i utvecklingen av de lösningar som möter morgondagens anslutningsbehov!
   

  

 Telekom är ryggraden i vår sammankopplade värld, och den utvecklas i en aldrig tidigare skådad takt, den överskrider gränser och förbinder människor samt företag över hela världen. Som projektledare inom detta område kommer du att spela en avgörande roll i att driva innovationen och teknikerna som formar hur människor kommunicerar, ansluter och samarbetar. Vad väntar du på, gå med oss idag och bli en del av teamet som bygger framtidens nätverk!
   

  

 I din roll som Projektledare hos oss på Syntronic kommer du att i kundprojekt leda ett eller flera projekt där Syntronic har totalansvar för kravhantering, systemering, design, integration, verifiering, produktionsuppstart samt volymupprampning.
   

  

**Som Projektledare inom produktutveckling hos oss kommer du bland annat att:**
* Ansvara för ett eller flera utvecklingsprojekt i produktprogram, från projektuppstart till avslut, för att leverera produkter med god kvalitet enligt tidsplan
* Leda projekt med ansvar för systemering, design, integration, verifiering och produktion
* Planera projekt, följa upp progress, hantera risker och kravändringar samt resursallokering
* Säkra koordinering samt leveranser mellan delprojekten
* Ansvara för att säkra teknikval, kvalitet, leverans och budget
* Rapportera status till relevanta styrgrupper och intressenter
* Förbereda samt presentera projektstatus, risker och relevant projektkostnader inför affärsbeslut.


 För att vara framgångsrik i rollen som Projektledare måste du ha en mycket god förmåga att hantera projektintressenter i en komplex organisation för att få stöd i att prioritera och supporta projektteamet att uppnå satta mål.
   

  

**Vi söker en Projektledare inom produktutveckling som:**
* Har en eftergymnasial utbildning med teknisk inriktning
* Har arbetslivserfarenhet som Projektledare inom projektledning
* Har erfarenhet från arbete med produktutveckling av hårdvara
* Har en stark förmåga att leda och motivera människor
* Har stor drivkraft samt flexibelt arbetssätt och förmåga att prioritera och uppnå resultat
* Behärskar svenska såväl som engelska flytande i tal och skrift.


 Meriterande är det om du Projektledare har erfarenhet från mjukvaruutveckling.
   

  

 Att vi är ett team är vår styrka och därför ser vi gärna att du arbetar på plats på något av våra kontor, de dagar du inte behövs hos någon av våra kunder förstås!
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 På Syntronic blir du en del av en härlig gemenskap där din röst hörs och dina idéer välkomnas. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider, balans mellan arbete och fritid samt regelbundna karriärutvecklingssamtal och interna workshops för din utveckling. Utöver detta får du förmånliga förmåner och försäkringar. Hos oss får du inte bara ett jobb – du får en plats att växa och trivas både personligt och professionellt. Välkommen till Syntronic!
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan, som ska vara oss tillhanda senast 5/11. Vi arbetar med löpande urval.
   

  

 Bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma.
   

  

 Av kommunikation- och kvalitetssäkringsskäl ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan digitalt via vårt system och inte via e-post.

title: Examensarbete: AI-baserad förutsägelse av LLM-kostnader
description:
**Övergripande beskrivning**
 Detta examensarbete syftar till att undersöka hur maskininlärning och molnbaserade tjänster kan användas för att förutsäga tokenförbrukning och kostnader vid användning av stora språkmodeller (LLM:er). I takt med att allt fler organisationer integrerar LLM:er i sina tjänster blir kostnaderna svåra att förutse, eftersom användningen ofta varierar kraftigt över tid och mellan olika applikationer. För höga prognoser leder till outnyttjad budget, medan för låga prognoser kan ge högre kostnader eller begränsningar i tjänsten. Arbetet ska utforska hur ett automatiserat system kan förutsäga användning, beräkna framtida kostnader och ge underlag för mer välgrundade inköpsbeslut.
   

  

**Projektbeskrivning**
 Projektet kommer att innebära att utforma, implementera och utvärdera en proof of concept-lösning för ett molnbaserat system som samlar in, bearbetar och analyserar användningsdata från LLM-tjänster. Systemet kan utvecklas och testas med hjälp av exempelvis publikt tillgängliga användningsloggar som simulerar verklig trafik. Studenten har stort utrymme att själv välja inriktning, tekniker och avgränsningar.
   

  

 Forskningen kommer att fokusera på att jämföra olika metoder för tidsserieprognoser, från klassiska statistiska modeller till maskininlärning och förtränade modeller, samt att omvandla prognoserna till kostnadsberäkningar för olika prismodeller, exempelvis förbetald kapacitet och användningsbaserad prissättning. Arbetet kan även omfatta hur prognoser, faktisk användning och avvikelser kan visualiseras och övervakas, samt i vilken utsträckning bättre prognoser leder till faktiska kostnadsbesparingar.
   

  

**Vem söker vi?**
* Masterutbildning inom datateknik, mjukvaruteknik, teknisk fysik eller närliggande område
* Inriktning mot maskininlärning, dataanalys eller molnutveckling är meriterande
* Examen i juni 2027
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
* Flytande engelska i tal och skrift


**Syfte**
 Syftet med examensarbetet är att skapa en djupare förståelse för hur väl tokenförbrukning kan förutsägas, vilka faktorer som påverkar prognosernas noggrannhet och hur prognoserna kan användas för att optimera kostnader. Resultatet förväntas bidra med kunskap kring hur organisationer kan planera och styra sin AI-användning mer effektivt, och ge underlag för framtida utveckling inom kostnadsoptimering och resursplanering för AI-tjänster.
   

  

**En spännande resa med Knightec Group**
 Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det?
   

  

 Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling.
   

  

 På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt.
   

  

**Praktisk information**
 Detta är en masteruppsats-tjänst med placering på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Startdatum är i januari 2027, exakta datum släpps närmre inpå.
   

  

 Det färdiga examensarbetet kan publiceras och användas både i din personliga portfölj och i företagets marknadsföring. Vänligen bifoga CV och personligt brev i din ansökan.
   

  

 Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-29. Om du har några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Hibatallah Belhajali på Hibatallah.belhajali@knightec.se. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

title: Utvecklingsledare till Bygglovsenheten
description:
**Drivs du av att omsätta idéer till verklig förändring? Bli vår nya utvecklingsledare!**
 Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter till förbättring och har både drivkraften och förmågan att omsätta dem i praktiken. Du trivs nära verksamheten, vågar utmana etablerade arbetssätt och är samtidigt lyhörd för dem som berörs av förändringen.
   

  

 Hos oss är digitalisering, automatisering och AI inte mål i sig. Det är verktyg för att skapa smartare arbetssätt, högre kvalitet och bättre service.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en utvecklingsledare som vill bli en nyckelspelare i vårt lag och bidra till att forma framtidens bygglovsverksamhet.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som utvecklingsledare är du en drivande kraft i bygglovenhetens utvecklingsarbete. Du fångar upp behov och möjligheter, skapar struktur och driver utvecklingen från idé och analys till genomförd förändring och uppföljd effekt.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära våra handläggare och chefer. En viktig del av uppdraget är att involvera dem som arbetar i processerna och skapa utveckling tillsammans med verksamheten, inte vid sidan av den.
   

  

 Du behöver kunna se både helheten och detaljerna. Ena dagen kan du tillsammans med handläggare utforska ett problem i en arbetsprocess, nästa dag driva utvecklingen av en digital lösning och därefter följa upp om förändringen faktiskt gav den effekt vi ville uppnå.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Driva utvecklingsarbete från behov och idé till genomförande, uppföljning och effekt.
* Kartlägga och utveckla processer tillsammans med handläggare, chefer och andra funktioner.
* Identifiera och driva möjligheter inom digitalisering, automatisering och AI.
* Skapa struktur, prioritering och framdrift när flera utvecklingsbehov behöver hanteras parallellt.
* Samordna utvecklingsbehov, följa upp resultat och bidra till kunskapsdelning och lärande.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* erfarenhet av att framgångsrikt leda utvecklings- och förändringsarbete
* erfarenhet av process- och verksamhetsutveckling
* erfarenhet av projektledning eller motsvarande arbete med att driva komplexa initiativ
* mycket god digital kompetens och förmåga att förstå hur digitalisering kan skapa verksamhetsnytta
* god analytisk förmåga och förmåga att omsätta analys i handling
* mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt.


 Meriterande
   

  

* kunskap om tjänstedesign, kundresor eller andra metoder för kundcentrerad verksamhetsutveckling
* erfarenhet av utveckling med hjälp av AI och automatisering.


 Vem är du?
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha ett starkt eget driv och en tydlig genomförandekraft. Du nöjer dig inte med att identifiera problem och ta fram förslag. Du vill se att förändringen verkligen blir genomförd och leder till resultat.
   

  

 Du är modig och nyfiken. Du vågar ställa frågor, utmana etablerade arbetssätt och testa nya vägar när du ser att något kan göras bättre.
   

  

 Samtidigt är du lyhörd och bra på att få människor med dig. Du förstår att hållbar förändring skapas tillsammans med dem som arbetar i verksamheten. Du kan fånga olika perspektiv, skapa samsyn och engagemang och sedan hjälpa gruppen att komma vidare till handling.
   

  

 Du arbetar systematiskt och uthålligt. Du skapar struktur även när frågorna är komplexa, följer upp resultat och lär av det som fungerar och det som behöver göras annorlunda.
   

  

 Och framför allt har du ett tydligt kund- och nyttoperspektiv. Du är nyfiken på hur vi kan göra det enklare och bättre för invånare och företag, samtidigt som vi stärker kvalitet, effektivitet och rättssäkerhet.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder
   

  

 Bygglovenheten består av 29 medarbetare och arbetar med bygglov, anmälan, tillsyn och bostadsanpassning. Här finns en bred kompetens inom bland annat arkitektur, teknik, juridik och samhällsplanering.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära nämndens utvecklingschef och får möjlighet att påverka vilka utvecklingsfrågor vi prioriterar och hur vi tar dem från idé till verklig förändring.
   

  

 Vi vill ligga i framkant. Under de senaste åren har vi utvecklat digitala tjänster, automatiserat beslut och genomfört flera uppmärksammade utvecklingsprojekt. Hos oss är utveckling inte ett sidospår. Det är en del av vår vardag.
   

  

 Som utvecklingsledare får du stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka hur framtidens samhällsservice och bygglovshandläggning ska fungera. Du arbetar nära enhetens ledning och andra utvecklingsfunktioner och får en central roll i att driva digitalisering, innovation och verksamhetsutveckling framåt.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder bland annat flextid, möjlighet att arbeta delvis på distans, gym i stadshuset, friskvårdstimme, friskvårdsersättning, förmånscykel och möjlighet att semesterväxla.
   

  

 Intresserad?
   

  

 Vill du vara med och utveckla en verksamhet där idéer får bli verklighet?
   

  

 Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.
   

  

 Tillsammans utvecklar vi framtidens bygglovsprocess.
   

  

 Tjänsten är en heltids tillsvidareanställning. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-23.
   

  

 Nacka är en av Sveriges mest attraktiva och välrenommerade kommuner. Med fokus på mål, resultat, hållbart medarbetarengagemang och ständig utveckling strävar Nacka efter att bli bäst på att vara kommun. Nacka kommun är arbetsgivaren för dig som med stor frihet förnyar och gör skillnad.

In this role, you will assist our clients within Banking, Insurance and Fintech to reshape their strategies & redesign and transform their business, services and operations - all while ensuring regulatory compliance and sustainability.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive, results- and development driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused, dynamic and learning environment. You will play a crucial role in shaping and implementing solutions for client challenges, particularly in our focus areas such as payments, open finance and sustainability.

 To work in an environment based upon trust, where we don’t compete internally and where everyone is seen as a valued member of the team. We believe that coaching, collaboration & learning while having fun and feeling psychological safety is the foundation for a high performing team!
   

  

 To be engaged on some of the most interesting and complex projects in the Financial Services sector, especially in the areas of payments, open finance, financial crime prevention and sustainability.
   

  

 Personal development and career progression based upon your own individual merit, which is not ruled by a hierarchal culture or process.
   

  

 Cidestra offers a competitive compensation model creating great opportunity for successful candidates.
   

  

 To be part of an alliance of twelve companies, that employ 260 consultants giving you the opportunity of being involved in a larger ecosystem of cultures and opportunities. This group is called Newground Alliance
   

  

 #Cidestra
   

  

 Cidestra is a management consulting firm focusing on strategy and transformation within the Financial Services industry.
   

  

 We have advised the leading financial institutions in the Nordics and in Europe in a wide range of initiatives, ranging from Strategy to Design and Implementation.
   

  

 Our company is part of the Newground Alliance - an alliance of independent niche consulting firms with various areas of expertise. The group has in total over 250 employees with office at Norrmalmstorg 14 in Stockholm.

description:
**30 hp – Efficient Vehicle-to-Cloud Telemetry over MQTT: Evaluating XCP-Based Data Transport and Predictive Compression**
**Introduction**
 Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project.
   

  

 TRATON GROUP is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers, with brands including Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. Its portfolio covers light commercial vehicles, trucks and buses, complemented by financing, charging and digital logistics services. Through its global operations, production sites and extensive sales and service networks, TRATON has access to diverse vehicle platforms, real-world operational data and fleet deployment environments. This provides a strong foundation for developing and validating innovative solutions for sustainable and efficient transportation.
   

  

 In the Cloud and Embedded Platform domain within TRATON, we develop new solutions for connected vehicles in our Internet of Things (IoT) platform, as part of TRATON’s increasing focus on communication, services and smart transport solutions.
   

  

  

  

**Background**
 Connected vehicles continuously generate measurement and diagnostic data that can support fleet services, vehicle development, maintenance, and cloud-based analytics. Transmitting this data from vehicles to cloud services over mobile networks introduces several challenges, including limited bandwidth, variable connectivity, communication cost, latency, and processing constraints in the vehicle.
   

  

 A typical data path begins with signals collected inside the vehicle. These signals must be extracted, encoded, transported through an onboard communication client, transmitted over the air, and reconstructed by a cloud-side receiver. The efficiency of this complete pipeline depends not only on the compression algorithm, but also on the data representation, protocol overhead, message structure, reliability mechanisms, and computational cost.
   

  

 Within the vehicle, standardization is important because the data originates from heterogeneous embedded systems. XCP is therefore a relevant candidate for representing and accessing measurement data on the vehicle side. However, the data must still be transported efficiently between the vehicle and the cloud. MQTT is a suitable candidate for this offboard communication because it is lightweight, widely supported, and designed for unreliable or bandwidth-constrained networks.
   

  

 This thesis will investigate how an efficient vehicle-to-cloud telemetry model can be designed by combining a standardized onboard data representation with an MQTT-based over-the-air transport layer.
   

  

**Objective**
 The aim of this thesis is to design and evaluate an efficient vehicle-to-cloud telemetry pipeline in which measurement data is collected using a standardized vehicle-side interface and transmitted over MQTT to a cloud-side receiver.
   

  

 The thesis will investigate how different encoding, batching, compression, and prediction strategies affect the overall efficiency of the communication path. The evaluation will consider not only compression ratio, but also bandwidth usage, latency, computational cost, memory consumption, reliability, and preservation of data accuracy.
   

  

**Main research question**
**How can vehicle measurement data be transported from an onboard client to a cloud receiver over MQTT with minimal bandwidth and latency while maintaining acceptable computational complexity and data fidelity?**
**Research questions**
**RQ1** 
 – End-to-end efficiency
   

  

 How do different data representations and transport strategies affect the total size and performance of vehicle-to-cloud telemetry over MQTT?
   

  

**RQ2** 
 – Role of standardization
   

  

 How can XCP-based measurement data be integrated into an MQTT-based vehicle-to-cloud communication model, and what protocol overhead does this introduce?
   

  

**RQ3** 
 – Compression and prediction
   

  

 Can signal-aware encoding, delta coding, or lightweight predictive models reduce bandwidth usage compared with conventional JSON, Protocol Buffers, and generic compression methods?
   

  

**If time allows**
**RQ4** 
 – System trade-offs
   

  

 What are the trade-offs between bandwidth reduction, latency, CPU usage, memory consumption, implementation complexity, and reconstruction accuracy?
   

  

 If time permits:
   

  

**RQ5** 
 – Impact on cloud analytics
   

  

 Does compression and reconstruction affect the performance of a downstream cloud analytics task, such as anomaly detection?
   

  

**Education/line/direction**
 Masters programmes in Computer Science, Electrical Engineer, or equivalent.
   

  

 Number of students: 1
   

  

 Start date for the Thesis project: Spring 2027
   

  

 Estimated timescale: 20 weeks
   

  

**Contact person and supervisor**
 Tomas Sjögren, Solution Architect, tomas.sjogren@scania.com
