title: Key Account Manager
description:
*Are you passionate about technology and building strong business relationships?* 
*If so, this could be your chance to make a real impact.* 




  





 ASUS is looking for a
 **B2C Key Account Manager** 
 to join our team in Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will play a key part in expanding our presence in the Retail and B2C segments, working with innovative products such Monitors, Wireless products, Components.
 



  





 At ASUS, our employees are given the opportunity to make a real impact. Through hard work, determination, and entrepreneurial thinking, we are shaping the future of technology together. That is something we are all immensely proud of.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You will join the ASUS Open Platform Sales Group, focusing on developing and expanding the Retail and B2C space in Nordic countries. As a Key Account Manager, you will manage and grow relationships with both new and existing customers.
 



  





 The role reports to our Country Head and Nordic Sales Manager based in Sweden, and you will have strong support from product managers, marketing, service, and back-office teams—all located in Stockholm, Kista. Your workplace will be our local ASUS office in Stockholm, Kista, where you’ll collaborate with around 100 colleagues.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 The ASUS OPBG B2C sales team currently consists of four salespeople and one sales manager in Sweden. In total, the ASUS Open Platform organization employs around 30 people across the Nordics. You’ll work closely with colleagues in sales, product management, marketing, and back office to ensure you have the best conditions to succeed.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage and develop strategic relationships with key Retail and Etail customers across the Nordic region.
* Conduct regular business reviews and customer meetings with retailers, partners, distributors, and key stakeholders to drive growth and strengthen long-term partnerships.
* Develop and execute customer-specific business plans, ensuring alignment with ASUS sales and marketing objectives.
* Drive assortment planning, product listings, ranging activities, and product lifecycle management together with customers.
* Own sales forecasting, demand planning, and sell-through analysis to maximize business performance and inventory efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to ensure successful execution of business plans.
* Represent ASUS at industry events, trade fairs, customer events, and partner engagements.
* Maintain a strong understanding of ASUS products, technologies, and market developments to provide value-added recommendations to customers.



  





**Qualifications and background** 



* Fluent in Swedish and English
* Minimum 5 years of successful B2C sales experience within the IT sector, with a strong understanding of industry dynamics and client needs.
* Great networking skills – You enjoy meeting new customers, building relationships, and representing our brand in the market.
* Entrepreneurial mindset – You don’t mind taking initiative to independently develop new opportunities and drive business growth.
* Knowledge and network within the B2C segment, including end-user entities , resellers & distributors.
* Knowledge of the Monitor, Wlan and Component segment is preferred but not required.



  





**About the Employment** 




**Scope:** 
 Full-time, permanent position with an initial 6-month probation period
 



**Start Date:** 
 As soon as possible, by agreement
 



**Workplace:** 
 ASUS Nordic AB – Stockholm (Torshamnsgatan 35, 16440 Kista)
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 30th of October. Kindly submit CV and personal letter in the same file.
 



  





 As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we encourage you to apply early. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English.
 



  





**About ASUS** 




 With over 35 years of experience in the tech industry, ASUS is a Taiwan-based, multinational computer hardware and consumer electronics company. Founded in 1989 as a motherboard manufacturer, ASUS components are found in the majority of computers worldwide. ASUS develops products across nearly all IT-related areas, including laptops, desktops, all-in-one PCs, tablets, smartphones, smartwatches, computer components, monitors, multimedia products, servers, networking equipment, and even home robots—dedicated to creating products for today’s and tomorrow’s smart life. Today, ASUS is the world’s No. 1 motherboard and gaming brand as well as a top-three consumer notebook vendor.
 



  





 ASUS currently employs more than 17,000 people globally, including 98 employees in the Nordics.

title: Business Operation Coordinator
description:
*För dig som vill ta nästa steg inom dagligvaruhandel, FMCG, AI och affärsutveckling* 




  





**Är du personen som ser vad som behöver göras och ser till att det blir gjort?** 




 Har du några års erfarenhet från butik, kategori, e-handel, säljstöd eller administration inom dagligvaruhandeln och känner att du vill ta nästa steg närmare affären?
 



 Då kan det här vara rätt roll för dig.
 



 Food Collective söker nu en Business Operations Coordinator som vill ta en nyckelroll i ett entreprenörsdrivet konsultföretag inom livsmedel, FMCG, retail och foodtech.
 



 Vi söker dig som gillar tempo, ansvar och ordning. Du är personen som tar initiativ, följer upp, hittar lösningar och driver saker hela vägen i mål.
 



  





**Om Food Collective** 




 Food Collective hjälper företag inom livsmedel och FMCG att växa genom affärsutveckling, försäljning och kommersiell strategi.
 



 Våra uppdragsgivare är entreprenörer, startups och etablerade varumärken. Vi arbetar med allt från produktdata och GS1 till presentationer, kunddialog och kommersiell utveckling.
 



  





 Vi tror på digitala arbetssätt och att AI kommer förändra hur framtidens företag arbetar. Därför söker vi någon som vill vara med och bygga nästa generation affärsstöd inom livsmedel och dagligvaruhandel.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 Som Business Operations Coordinator blir du navet i verksamheten. Du arbetar nära VD, konsulter, kunder och samarbetspartners och säkerställer att projekt, processer och leveranser håller tempo, kvalitet och riktning.
 



 Det här är en bred roll för dig som tycker om att kombinera struktur med affärsförståelse. Ena dagen kan du arbeta med kundmaterial och uppföljning, nästa med artikeladministration, GS1, aviseringar eller förbättringar i våra digitala arbetssätt.
 



  





**Du kommer bland annat att** 




**•** 
 Koordinera projekt, kunder och interna leveranser
 



**•** 
 Säkerställa framdrift genom att följa upp aktiviteter, deadlines och leveranser tills de är genomförda
 



**•** 
 Ta fram presentationer, offerter och kundmaterial
 



**•** 
 Arbeta med GS1, artikeladministration, produktdata och masterdata
 



**•** 
 Hantera aviseringar och koordinering mot kunder och handelspartners
 



**•** 
 Bygga struktur i digitala system och processer
 



**•** 
 Utforska och implementera AI-verktyg och smarta automatiseringar
 



**•** 
 Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta dem i praktiken
 



**•** 
 Bidra till att höja kvalitet, effektivitet och tempo i verksamheten
 



**Kort sagt: du ser till att saker blir genomförda.** 




  





**Vem är du?** 




 Vi tror att du är i början av din karriär men redan har hunnit bygga en bra förståelse för dagligvaruhandel, retail eller FMCG. Du har kanske har erfarenhet från kategori, försäljningsstöd, e-handel, administration, orderflöden, produktdata eller drift och vill in i en roll med mer ansvar, större utveckling och närmare koppling till affären.
 



 Du är strukturerad och noggrann, men framför allt är du handlingskraftig. När något behöver göras väntar du inte på att någon annan ska ta tag i det.
 



  





 Vi tror att du har:
 



**•** 
 2–5 års erfarenhet från dagligvaruhandeln, FMCG, retail, e-handel eller liknande
 



**•** 
 Erfarenhet av administration, koordinering, försäljningsstöd, operations eller kundnära arbete
 



**•** 
 Vana att arbeta i digitala system och lätt för att lära dig nya verktyg
 



**•** 
 Starkt intresse för AI, automatisering och digital utveckling
 



**•** 
 Förmåga att prioritera när tempot är högt och flera saker händer samtidigt
 



**•** 
 Du bor i Stockholm och kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska samt har goda kunskaper i engelska
 



  





**Extra meriterande** 




**•** 
 Erfarenhet av GS1 och artikeladministration
 



**•** 
 Erfarenhet från dagligvaruhandel, FMCG, retail eller livsmedelsbranschen
 



**•** 
 E-handelsplattformar eller digitala affärssystem
 



 • Artikelinformation & masterdata
 



**•** 
 Excel, PowerPoint och analysarbete
 



**•** 
 Automatiserings- och AI-verktyg
 



**Viktigast av allt är ägarskap: du ser vad som behöver göras, tar initiativ utan att bli tillsagd och följer upp tills saker är klara. Du tar ansvar för resultatet inte bara uppgiften.** 




  





**Därför kommer du att trivas hos oss** 




 Du får en central roll i ett växande bolag där du arbetar nära ledningen, kunderna och affären och där din förmåga att skapa struktur och framdrift gör verklig skillnad.
 



**•** 
 Stor frihet under ansvar
 



**•** 
 Möjlighet att växa i takt med bolaget
 



**•** 
 Nära inblick i spännande företag inom livsmedel, FMCG och retail
 



**•** 
 Praktisk erfarenhet av AI, digitalisering och nya arbetssätt
 



**•** 
 Snabba beslutsvägar, högt tempo och stort förtroende från dag ett
 



**•** 
 En chans att ta nästa steg från dagligvaruhandeln in i en bredare affärs- och operationsroll
 



  





**Placering och ansökan** 




 Placering: Skeppsbron 28, Stockholm.
 



 Skicka din ansökan till jenny.kopper@foodcollective.se. Vi intervjuar löpande.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
At Zaver, we develop innovative payment solutions to accelerate the revolution of mobile payments and enable a frictionless shopping experience. Working with us you will make a real impact, both within the company and the industry. With the right mindset and ambition, you will find a lot of room to grow and thrive. Right now, we are growing rapidly and looking for customer-obsessed all-star players to join our teams. We’re a bunch of techy, passionate, and hard-working friendly people.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Manage incoming cases to our customer support via phone, chat, and email
* Office Manager responsibilities, ensuring a well-organized workspace
* Proactively help customers by analyzing customer transactions
* Track customer health metrics
* Be the voice of the customer; bring real customer insights to the product development team
* Make our customers our super-ambassadors
* Make a real impact by challenging the status quo



  





 You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, with one goal: to keep our customer base happy while expanding. No issue is too small or too big - you’ll do whatever it takes to find a solution.

 **Swedish** 
 and

title: Senior Consultant – Real Estate & Property Management
description:
We partner with clients from initial concept through to execution, driving real change across strategy, service design, operational improvement, and digital enablement. Our mission is to lead end-to-end transformations that create tangible, sustainable results. We know that a deep understanding of the business we support makes us better business partners and advisors, and combining strategy with execution makes us better in ensuring real impact for our clients.
   

  

 Real estate and property management has grown into one of our three core sectors, with an established client portfolio that includes clients in the commercial real estate segment as well as property management for both commercial and housing cooperatives. We are now looking for a senior consultant to help us scale this business, someone who combines strong delivery capability with a genuine ability to win work at CXO level.
   

  

 Our focus is on making real estate companies and property management organisations more operationally efficient and relevant. Improving business models, governance, customer journeys, processes, and the way they deliver and manage their portfolios.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead and deliver management consulting engagements for real estate companies and property management organisations. Covering operational efficiency, business model improvement, process optimisation, and customer journey design
* Develop client relationships at senior (CXO) level and contribute actively to business development (networking, pitching, proposing, and winning new assignments)
* Support clients with the full range of property management challenges: economic and technical property management, service offering development, organisational improvement, and portfolio and programme delivery
* Bring insight and structure to complex client problems. Facilitating workshops, communicating findings to senior leadership, and driving measurable results
* Help build Avanti's positioning and reputation in the real estate market
* Mentor and develop more junior consultants as the team grows


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5–10 years of experience from a management consultancy with a clear focus on property owners and/or property management organisations
* Experience leading and executing projects with senior management or middle management as key stakeholders
* Strong project management and delivery capability, with a track record of driving change and efficiency initiatives from analysis through to implementation
* Experience of transformation work, preferably with a link to digitalisation, data, AI, or systems support within areas such as property management, leasing, or space and facilities provision
* Experience from an operational or strategic role within a real estate company, bringing a genuine understanding of the practical challenges and business drivers in the sector
* Strong drive for new areas and willingness to learn and improve, take responsibility for continuous competence development
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, you are as comfortable in a workshop as you are in a boardroom
* Good commercial acumen and understanding of economics and business performance management in real estate operations
* An established network within the real estate sector
* Comfortable contributing to business development and sales activities alongside senior colleagues, you understand how to help win work, not just deliver it
* Fluent in Swedish
* Degree in business, engineering, economics, real estate development or a related field


**What We Offer**
* A focused, high-impact role in a boutique consulting firm, you will be a key driver of Avanti's real estate sector, with real commercial ownership and influence on direction
* A people-powered culture: a collective of sharp, forward-thinking professionals who support and challenge each other, built on mutual respect, inclusion, and genuine care for individual growth and wellbeing
* A human-centric organisation in a meritocracy-oriented environment, where your ideas and voice truly matter
* The chance to build a team around you as the real estate sector scales
* Opportunities to develop your leadership, project management, and business development capabilities
* Access to a wide range of internal and external learning and development opportunities
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* Access to the Newground Alliance ecosystem, 14 specialist consultancies and approximately 300 consultants.


 We are a management consulting firm focusing on the Financial Services sector. This includes life, health and property & casualty insurance as well as retail and commercial banking. Our services include Strategy & Business Design, Operational Design & Implementation, Service Design, and Digital Enablement. We support our clients throughout the entire project life cycle, i.e., from design to execution.

title: Workforce Management Expert
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**




 As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
   

  





 You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
   

  





 You will:
   

  




* Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
* Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
* Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
* Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
* Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
* Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
* Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
* Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
* Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
* Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
* Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
* Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance



**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**




 You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
   

  





 We are looking for people with:
   

  




* Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
* Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
* Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
* Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
* Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
* Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
* Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
* Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken



**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





 An example of our benefits:
   

  




* 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
* H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.



**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





 This is a
 **permanent position** 
 based in
 **Stockholm** 
 , please send your
 **CV in English** 
 as soon as possible.
   

  

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: Strategic Account Executive - Sweden - Retail
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
   

  

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
   

  

**We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms**
* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

* High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


 What we offer
   

  

* Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


 We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Sweden's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Retail. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swedish retail and consumer brands — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.
   

  

 In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Sweden, with a primary focus on Retail and consumer brands, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.
* Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for retail organizations.
* Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.
* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to Swedish retail and consumer brand organizations.
* Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.
* Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swedish retail sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.
* Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.


**Requirements**
* 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.
* Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.
* Well-connected in the Swedish retail landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.
* Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.
* Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Sweden, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.
* Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.
* Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.
* A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.
* Native or full professional proficiency in Swedish; strong English for internal collaboration.


**Location**
 This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Stockholm. You can work remotely or from our office in Stockholm.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Content Manager - H&M Global Marketing
description:

title: Testare till inhouse-team!
description:
Nexer MyTeam har i uppdrag att utveckla och effektivisera den samhällsnyttiga digitala tjänsten 1177.se. Nu söker vi efter en testare /testledare till vårat team i Örebro som vill vara med på denna resa. Vill du varje dag känna att du åstadkommer skillnad och bidrar till en samhällsviktig funktion i jobbet du gör? Tveka inte på att ansöka!

**Om rollen**


Vårt inhouse-team MyTeam arbetar med kundfokuserade lösningar, där du är med i både nyutveckling och löpande underhåll. Det finns även stora möjligheter att vara med och förbättra funktionen för 1177.se. Vi söker dig som är en äkta lagspelare och värdesätter samarbete.


Teamet du ingår i består av utvecklare, testare och arkitekter – alla med samma mål: att skapa långsiktiga och framgångsrika lösningar. MyTeam erbjuder trygghet, kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter.

**Bakgrund**


På MyTeam har vi två centrala målsättningar; att leverera stabila lösningar som genererar nöjda kunder och att skapa trygga team med lyckliga medarbetare. Tack vare lång erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemförvaltning är de processer vi använder väl beprövade och framgångsrika, och underlättar för oss att göra lyckade kundanpassningar efter krav och önskemål.

**Hur ser rollen ut?**


Hos oss planerar du testarbetet och skriver testplaner, prioriterar, resurssäkrar testuppdraget samt följer upp och förbättrar testprocessen. Dessutom koordinerar du testarbetet samt sköter teamuppföljning.


Med dina kollegor på Nexer delar du kunskap och tillsammans bygger vi kompetens och tar oss an de stora utmaningarna. Att bygga och dela kompetens är viktigt för oss. Att gå kurser och ta certifieringar välkomnas alltid.

**Din bakgrund**


Du har arbetat några år med testautomatisering i större och mindre testprojekt. Vi tror att du har stor vana av agila tillvägagångssätt, till exempel Scrum och SAFe samt DevOps. Du är mycket bekväm med Playwright eller liknande tekniker såsom Selenium.


Troligen är du utbildad systemvetare, ingenjör eller liknande. Det är meriterande om du har programmeringserfarenhet, t ex i JavaScript, Java och/eller C#


Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för oss då vill behålla den atmosfär vi har idag. Våra medarbetare kännetecknas av en affärsmässig och kundorienterad attityd, samt förmåga att snabbt ta till sig ny information och omvandla den till kreativa lösningar. Du respekterar dina kollegor och har en stark vilja att dela med dig av dina kunskaper till andra samt lyssna och lära.


Vi letar efter personer som säger VI och inte JAG.


Sist men inte minst, vi vill att du skall fortsätta att utvecklas och ha kul på jobbet!

###### **Ansökan**


Du ansöker genom att fylla i ansökningsformuläret nedan. Tyvärr kan vi inte ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Har du några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta vår rekryterare, Natalie Svensson, på Natalie.Svensson@nexergroup.com.

title: Scrum Master 800xA Core Team
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


R&D Department Lead
\_\_

**Your Role and Resposibilities**
---------------------------------

  

Your primary responsibility is to serve as **Scrum Master** for the System 800xA Core Team. Roughly half your time will be spent on planning, tracking, and facilitating team agility. The rest of your time will be spent **contributing hands-on** as an active member in the team.


The System 800xA Core Team is a cross-functional unit responsible for managing system-wide implementations and coordination across our global development streams. The team is distributed across Västerås, Malmö, and Bangalore, working in close daily collaboration with colleagues worldwide.


You will orchestrate and track all team activities in a unified backlog, driving the planning and effectiveness. Over time, you will grow into one or more of the team's core responsibility areas.

  

This role reports to the 800xA System Stream Lead and is based in Västerås or Malmö, Sweden.


The System-level responsibilities consist of Release management, 3rd party software management, cybersecurity coordination, user documentation integration, and automation of repetitive tasks amongst other. Further discussion and description of these areas will be done in more detail during our conversations with candidates.

 **Your responsibilities include:**

* Plan, coordinate, and track all activities across the System Core Team using the team backlog.
* Facilitate effective collaboration and communication between the team, Product Owner, and other key stakeholders.
* Create, maintain, and monitor the team's delivery plan, ensuring transparency of sprint progress and performance.
* Coach and support team members in Agile ways of working, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and sprint planning activities.
* Contribute hands-on to team activities while continuously expanding your system-level knowledge and expertise.
* Monitor backlog health, including estimation accuracy, sprint commitments, burndown progress, and delivery outcomes.
* Ensure clear and effective communication between the team and stakeholders in close partnership with the Product Owner.
* Drive alignment with PCP principles and processes while actively identifying and implementing improvements.

 **Qualifications for the Role**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development, or a related field.
* Good understanding of software development processes and practices.
* Interest in and understanding of Agile methodologies, such as Scrum, SAFe, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps and a strong willingness to further develop expertise in the tool.
* Strong curiosity, learning agility, and a passion for exploring new areas and challenges.
* Previous experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or in a similar Agile coordination role is preferred.
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, or equivalent) is considered an advantage.
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in both English and Swedish.

**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------


We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward.


At ABB, you’ll find benefits that reflect how much we value your time, talent, and future.

**More about us**
-----------------


You will be part of Process Control Platform (PCP) which is a unit within ABB Business Area Process Automation. PCP develops automation products - hardware and software - for monitoring, process control and optimization. We have automation products for all kinds of industries all over the world

  

Jonas Stigeberg, +46 70 665 50 60 will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Kenneth Hultman, +46 70 349 60 95; Ledarna: Leif Öhrberg, +46 72 464 40 16; Unionen: Mikael Hammar, +46 73 088 70 60. Talent Partner: Anna Nordlund

  

We look forward to reading your application in PDF format. Please note that the interview process is ongoing, apply now to secure your spot in the recruitment process! Last day to apply is October 16.


Please note that to be eligible for employment at ABB Sweden, you will need to pass our pre-employment screening steps. This includes a reference check, a drug test, and could also include an extended background check.


We kindly decline direct contact with staffing and recruitment agencies as well as sellers of additional job advertisements.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.




Ready to make an impact?


Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: DevOps Engineer - SRE focus
description:
**About the Role**


Wolters Kluwer is looking for an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to join GBS – GTS Application & Technology Partners, within Wolters Kluwer Scandinavia AB. This role is primarily focused on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and the operational support of customer-facing applications hosted in Microsoft Azure.

  

You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, availability, performance and resilience of established cloud applications used by our customers. Working within a mature DevSecOps environment, you will operate, maintain and continuously improve our existing Azure-based cloud platform.

  

Working closely with Engineering, Cloud Operations, Security and other key stakeholders, you will troubleshoot production issues, improve monitoring and observability, automate operational processes, maintain Infrastructure as Code and support CI/CD pipelines.

  

This is primarily a production-focused SRE and operations role rather than a greenfield cloud architecture position. Success will come from your ability to understand complex environments quickly, identify opportunities for improvement and implement pragmatic solutions within established enterprise frameworks and standards.

  

You will join an experienced, globally connected team working with proven cloud solutions already in production. From day one, you will be able to build on established best practices while contributing through automation, improved monitoring and AI-supported troubleshooting to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure the reliability, availability and performance of customer-facing applications hosted in Azure.
* Monitor, investigate and resolve incidents and production platform issues.
* Apply SRE principles across incident management, observability, capacity planning, root cause analysis and reduction of operational toil.
* Support and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure, including diagnostics, logging and performance optimisation.
* Maintain and extend existing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Identify and automate repetitive operational processes to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Support and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps and GitHub.
* Work closely with development teams to improve application stability and production readiness.
* Collaborate with Security teams to ensure established security and compliance standards are followed.
* Develop scripts and tools using Python, Bash or similar technologies to improve operational workflows.
* Work within established cloud architecture, engineering and governance standards.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of platform operations, monitoring and support processes.
* Use AI tools where appropriate to support troubleshooting, automation and day-to-day engineering activities.
* Participate in an on-call rotation of approximately one week in four during peak tax season (March–July) to support business continuity.

 **What We're Looking For**

**Essential Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Approximately 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering or a similar production-focused engineering role.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting cloud-based applications in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience with CI/CD tools, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub, including troubleshooting pipelines.
* Strong understanding of application and infrastructure operations, including incident management, monitoring and root cause analysis.
* Scripting experience using Python, Bash or similar technologies, particularly for automation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.
* A strong operational mindset with a focus on reliability, automation and continuous improvement.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience with container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools for troubleshooting, automation or operational support.
* Experience working within a large-scale enterprise or matrix organisation with established governance and engineering standards.

 **About You**


You enjoy solving complex production problems and improving the reliability of systems that customers depend on. You are comfortable working within an established enterprise environment and understand that effective engineering is not always about building something new. You can quickly understand existing platforms, identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical solutions that make systems more resilient and easier to operate. You are collaborative, analytical and proactive, with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in using automation to reduce manual effort. Most importantly, you bring an SRE mindset: you care about reliability, observability, operational excellence and continuously improving production systems.

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Platform Manager (Public Cloud) | Technology & Platform
description:
**Company Description**  

Hej Platform Manager! Ready to help shape the future with smart, innovative solutions?


At IKEA, you can feel at home while making a difference for millions. We’re a place where everyone is welcome, encouraged to explore new tech, try new things and grow from mistakes. As our Platform Manager, you’ll have the chance to lead the evolution of our cloud foundation, turning complex hyperscale capabilities into a seamless product for the many.


We are transforming the Technology and Platform organisation to build a modern and scalable technology foundation for Inter IKEA. To make this shift possible, we need an organisation that is fully aligned with our Operating Model: one that works with a strong product‑ and platform‑thinking mindset and is ready to take full accountability from strategy to operations.

 **Job Description**  

About the role


As Platform Manager for Public Cloud, you guide our cloud platform domains, so they run smoothly, securely, and cost‑effectively and always aligned with IKEA standards. With a clear eye on performance and compliance, you make sure our public‑cloud platforms are dependable foundations for the many digital solutions across IKEA.


We have currently 4 -5 cloud teams covering Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI and Alibaba Cloud.


You lead the full platform lifecycle with a focus on removing friction:

* Platform-as-a-Product: You treat our cloud capabilities as a product, where your success is measured by the velocity and autonomy of the engineering teams who consume them.
* Automated Guardrails: You lead the shift toward Policy-as-Code, replacing manual compliance checks with automated, "invisible" guardrails that allow teams to stay secure by default.


Working across our technology and platform networks, you connect the needs of different stakeholders into one shared direction. You communicate roadmaps and activity plans in a simple and inspiring way, build awareness around platform capabilities, and strengthen adoption of common ways of working, tools, and processes. Along the way, you nurture close relationships with our suppliers, ensuring contracts, governance, and collaboration follow IKEA ways of working.


Leading people is a big part of the job. You grow high‑performing, curious teams with the skills we need today and in the future. Through competence development, succession planning, and an innovation mindset, you create the conditions for teams to thrive. You also take responsibility for budget planning, cost monitoring, and optimising spend. And by encouraging DevOps practices, automation, and a great developer experience, you help shorten delivery cycles and make life easier for engineering teams across IKEA.

 **Qualifications**  

You combine technical depth with a product leadership mindset. You understand that a great cloud platform is one that gets out of the way of the developer while maintaining total resilience. You lead with IKEA values, developing a high-performing team that takes total ownership of the platform’s success.


You are a pioneer of modern cloud engineering, comfortable with:

* Landing Zone Automation: Treating infrastructure as software to create a consistent, global foundation.
* Policy-as-Code (OPA): Using technology to enable safe, decentralized decision-making.
* Developer Experience (DevEx): A passion for shortening delivery cycles together with the DevEx platform team, and making life easier for engineering teams.


You understand how IKEA works as a franchise system and have a good sense of our strategic direction and core business needs. You enjoy translating complex technical topics into simple business language, staying close to market trends and emerging technologies to guide future decisions. Budget awareness, cost optimisation and strong organisational skills help you lead transformation in a clear and structured way, even in fast‑changing or ambiguous situations.


You’re a people‑centred leader who develops high‑performing technical teams and builds strong collaboration across units. Motivated by the IKEA culture and values, you bring energy to platform development and take initiative to drive results. You know how to influence others, navigate complexity and integrate governance, security and resilience into platform strategies. With a growth mindset, excellent communication skills and a passion for continuous improvement, you help create better solutions for the many.


To be successful in this role, the following knowledge, skills and experiences would be valuable:

* Total Accountability: Proven experience in owning a large-scale public cloud domain, from strategy to unit cost economics (FinOps).
* Product-Led Mindset: A track record of building platforms that focus on ease-of-use, self-service, and high adoption.
* Strategic Influence: The ability to move the organization toward cloud-native adoption through mentorship and shared standards.
* Resilience & Security-by-Design: An "automated-first" approach to risk management and compliance.
* Hands‑on experience with software engineering at scale, such as landing zone automation, Policy‑as‑Code (OPA) and working with hyperscaler shared‑responsibility models.
* Proven ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams, coach others and drive organisational change across mixed sourcing models.
* Experience owning budgets and managing cost within a defined domain or organisational area.
* Deep knowledge of technology trends, emerging solutions and best practices for platform lifecycle management, modernisation and portfolio governance.
* Ability to apply security‑by‑design and privacy‑by‑design principles, take ownership of risk prevention and lead remediation activities.
* Awareness of regulatory changes, compliance requirements and digital risk management in platform delivery.
* Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making skills, combining analytical thinking with hands‑on operational experience to optimise complex technology landscapes.

 **Additional Information**  

At IKEA, we think and work differently. We challenge old patterns and create new solutions, whether that’s a music-playing lamp or plant-based food that’s better for the planet. Our vision is simple: to create a better everyday life for the many people.


In Technology and Platform, we support the whole organisation by providing reliable technology and digital platforms that are easy to use and built for the future. By working closely with others across IKEA, we turn technology into real value and support ongoing transformation.


This is a full-time position located in Malmö. The role reports into the Platform Area Manager – Core Infra and Compute Platforms and belongs to the Technology and Platform area within Operations Management. It is an enabling function with the core assignment to lead, develop, and maintain the common foundation for how Inter IKEA works across the value chain. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please connect with recruiter Calvin Blyth (calvin.blyth2@inter.ikea.com)


Interested? Submit your CV and let us know why you would be a good fit for this role, in English, by the 15th of October 2026.
