title: Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation
description:
**Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation**
===========================================================


Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.


**About the Role**
------------------


We are hiring a Software Test Engineer to own software verification for a Class III medical device system spanning embedded firmware, desktop applications and the communication between them. This is a verification role in the regulatory sense: you will derive test cases from approved software requirements, demonstrate objectively that the software meets them, and produce the traceable, auditable evidence that supports the design history file and technical documentation.


You will also develop and maintain the automation that makes verification repeatable. Using a Python-based test framework integrated with CI/CD, you will help turn regression testing from extensive manual work into reliable pipeline-driven execution.


You will analyse software requirements and design specifications for testability, ambiguity and measurable acceptance criteria. You will create verification plans, protocols and test cases, select and justify suitable verification methods, define expected results and pass/fail criteria, and maintain traceability from requirement through execution record to result.


The role also includes executing protocols under configuration control, documenting objective evidence, managing deviations and amendments, investigating defects, and writing verification reports. You will contribute to design reviews and audits by clearly explaining and defending the verification approach.


On the automation side, you will design, build and maintain test frameworks and automated suites across unit, integration and system levels. This includes developing test harnesses, simulators, stubs and fixtures, as well as supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing where appropriate. You will integrate suites into GitHub Actions and help ensure that automated results can serve as reliable verification evidence.


**About You**
-------------


You have experience of working with software testing in a regulated environment and understand the importance of disciplined design control, configuration management and technical documentation. You are comfortable moving between detailed test work and the broader verification argument, and you can distinguish between requirement, implementation and test defects.


To succeed in the role, you combine a rigorous, structured approach with practical engineering judgement. You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating closely with software, firmware, systems and QA/RA colleagues to keep requirements, code and tests aligned.


**What we Offer**
-----------------


This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of verification in a complex medical device environment and to contribute to both the verification process and the automation infrastructure that supports it. You will work across embedded firmware, desktop applications and connected interfaces, with a clear opportunity to influence templates, tooling and workflows as verification needs evolve. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.


**Application**
---------------


We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from **18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026.**


For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64. Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.


**Requirements**
----------------


* Experience of software testing in medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
* Understanding of formal design control or safety lifecycles, including the distinction between design verification and design validation.
* Demonstrated experience of requirements-driven test design, including defining objective acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability, and producing verification protocols and reports suitable for audit.
* Experience of building and maintaining automated test suites, including framework design, test data management and test fixtures.
* Experience of version control, change control and formal defect management.
* Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
* Strong spoken and written English.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, computer science or a closely related technical field; equivalent demonstrable experience is also valued.
* Working familiarity with .NET/C# and C++, including the ability to read code, understand architecture and create meaningful integration tests.
* Practical Python experience for test automation, using a framework such as pytest, unittest or Robot Framework.
* CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, including workflow YAML, runners, matrices, secrets, caching and artifacts.
* Experience of IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, including software safety classification, testing expectations, SOUP management and anomaly evaluation.
* Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR technical documentation and IEC 62366 usability engineering.
* Experience of ALM or requirements-management tools such as Polarion, Jama, Codebeamer, DOORS or Azure DevOps, including generating trace matrices.
* Experience of embedded or hardware-adjacent testing, for example serial protocols, CAN bus, instrument control, logic analysers, test rigs or hardware-in-the-loop frameworks.
* Experience of static analysis, code coverage measurement and their role in software verification.
* Experience of FDA inspections, notified body audits, or regulatory submissions such as 510(k), PMA or CE submissions.
* Exposure to cybersecurity testing for connected medical devices.

**About Scandinavian Real Heart**
---------------------------------


Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?


Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many  

patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution.


Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team  

placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

**About the Role**




 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Platform Engineer** 
 to help us develop and operate our Kubernetes-based multi-cluster internal developer platform that powers mission-critical microservices across the organization.
   

  





 You will work closely with product teams, platform architects, and engineering managers to evolve our platform into a highly automated, self-service ecosystem that accelerates developer productivity and enables secure, seamless deployments at scale.
   

  





 Our technical stack includes
 **Azure Kubernetes Service, Envoy Gateway, Opentelemetry Operator, LGTM Stack, Crossplane, KEDA, Cert Manager, External DNS, Kyverno, External Secrets Operator, Argo CD, Helm, Bicep, Github Actions.**




**What You’ll Do**



* Treat the platform as a product. This involves gathering feedback, identifying friction, and continuously improving workflows and interfaces.
* Design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure with an everything-as-code mindset.
* Write production-quality code (Bash, YAML, Bicep, Github Actions)
* Drive complex features and refactoring efforts across provisioning, deployments, observability, and cluster lifecycle management.
* Partner closely with product teams to understand real workflows and deliver a frictionless self-service experience.



**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**




 You will be working in a team with experienced Platform Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers within Platform Engineering. Our sister-teams within Platform Engineering area are Quality Engineering, Development Tools and Applications (CICD/Applications scaffolding).
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**



* 5+ experience in platform engineering, SRE, or application engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and the cloud-native ecosystem.
* A builder mindset - you write and ship code regularly.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Experience operating in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with modern IaC and GitOps tooling.
* Proven track record improving developer workflows, self-service capabilities, or internal platforms.
* Understanding of networking (TLS, DNS, HTTP, GRPC, proxies).
* Experience with modern observability practices and tooling (instrumentation, metrics, logs, tracing, profiling).



**WHY JOIN US**



* Make a real impact - you’ll have significant influence over the direction of the platform and shape how platform engineering works across the company.
* Platform at the center of transformation - as the organization continues its transition to microservices, the platform sits at pole position, with rapid growth and growing strategic importance.
* Modern, cloud-native stack - we invest in staying current with the cloud-native ecosystem and evolving our architecture accordingly.
* Ideas matter here - we value curiosity, experimentation, and thoughtful innovation, and give engineers space to turn ideas into reality.
* Supportive, low-ego culture - you’ll work with collaborative teammates who care about helping each other succeed and building great things together.



**WHO WE ARE**
  

 H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we use our scale and knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
  

  




* At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
* All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
* Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online
* Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year
* Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more
* Compensation boost during parental leave



**JOIN US** 
  

  





 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 This is a full-time, permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is hybrid, based in Stockholm, Sweden, where close collaboration with stakeholders is an important part of the role.
   

  





 Apply by submitting your
 **CV in English** 
 as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.
   

  





 We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Ingrid is a leading European startup that solves delivery optimisation for retailers and customers. We partner with major carriers, cart platforms and brands you surely have heard of (DHL, InPost, Shopify, Paul Smith, NA-KD) - our customers love us.
   

  

**About You**
 You’re a Staff Engineer who thrives on high-ambiguity, high-impact problems. You combine deep technical judgment with the ability to lead through influence.
   

  

 You raise the bar for engineering quality, help teams align on architectural direction, and unblock delivery across domains. You’re comfortable being accountable for critical parts of the system, and you care about long-term maintainability, reliability, cost efficiency, and security.
   

  

**Qualification**
* 8–11+ years of software engineering experience (or equivalent track record of impact)
* Strong track record delivering 6+ month initiatives with broad product and technical impact
* Expertise in distributed systems design and development
* Proven ability to mentor and coach senior engineers and shape engineering standards, vision and strategy by example
* Excellent communication skills for driving alignment across engineering, product, and other stakeholders


**Requirements**
* Deep understanding of system design, scalability, and reliability trade-offs
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and modern container platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
* Strong fundamentals in Linux/Unix systems and networking
* Experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces) and tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry)
* Strong understanding of security and cloud architecture principles
* Fluent command of AI in engineering and building, maintaining, promoting a scalable SDLC with AI


**Responsibilities**
* Own and drive company-wide, high-leverage initiatives that improve developer experience, platform stability and enable new business opportunities
* Lead high-ambiguity, mission-critical projects and define execution paths that balance speed, quality, and long-term sustainability
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, RFCs, and design documents, driving alignment across teams, be able to jump in hands-on and get hands dirty when needed
* Be a technical subject matter expert in one or more key domains and set a strong engineering quality bar
* Coach and mentor senior engineers, helping grow technical leadership across the organization
* Partner with engineering and product leaders to identify and remove systemic delivery blockers


**Tech Stack**
 Go, TypeScript, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Grafana Cloud, Prometheus, Sentry, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker
   

  

**What We Offer**
* High trust & transparency, low control environment
* Competitive market pay and benefits (depending on the location)
* Meaningful work every single day that challenges the industry and is just fun
* Hack culture and regular hackathons, retreats & offsites (travel involved at least once a quarter for team in person meetings)
* Partnering with best in class engineering, product and commercial folks that you can learn from
* Modern equipment, tools and premium AI licences
* Freedom of how you organise your work, overlap with work hours (9-17 CET) is required for effective real-time collaboration
* Two offices - Stockholm and Wroclaw with snacks and good coffee, two days from the office mandatory

title: AI-Utvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla AI- och ML-tjänster som faktiskt går i produktion och gör verklig skillnad för människor och djur? Hos oss får du kombinera modern fullstackutveckling med avancerad AI, från NLP och chatbotar till bildigenkänning, i en miljö där du är med och formar både arkitektur och lösning.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du blir en central del i ett team som bygger intelligenta tjänster ovanpå en modern Azure-plattform. Här jobbar du både med klassisk systemutveckling och hands-on AI-utveckling. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan backend i .NET, frontend i React och AI-komponenter i Python, och du är med hela vägen från idé och prototyp till produktion och vidare optimering.
   

  

 IT och affären jobbar nära tillsammans, vilket betyder att du snabbt ser effekten av det du bygger. Du samarbetar tätt med andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att våra lösningar hänger ihop från frontend till backend – och att AI-funktionaliteten faktiskt används och skapar värde.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Bygga moderna frontend-lösningar med React, TypeScript och microfrontend-arkitektur
* Jobba testdrivet och bidra till hög kvalitet i koden
* Designa och implementera integrationer med både synkrona och asynkrona mönster
* Vara delaktig i mjukvaruarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Bygga och optimera CI/CD-pipelines med Azure och Azure DevOps
* Automatisera miljöer och infrastruktur med Bicep
* Utveckla och implementera avancerade AI-lösningar med fokus på NLP, intelligenta system och bildigenkänning
* Bygga, integrera och optimera chatbotar och språkmodeller (inklusive generativ AI)


 För att lyckas i tjänsten tror vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av generativ AI och av att ha deployat applikationer i produktion
* God kunskap av fullstack-utveckling med .NET och React
* Vana av testdriven eller testfokuserad utveckling
* Erfarenhet av integration mot synkrona och asynkrona gränssnitt/mönster
* Förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur och hur man bygger skalbara lösningar
* Erfarenhet av att bygga CI/CD-pipelines med Azure som målplattform
* Kunskaper i Bicep
* Flytande i både svenska och engelska


 Som person är du drivande och resultatfokuserad, med en stark nyfikenhet på ny teknik. Du kan växla mellan att arbeta självständigt och i team, och du har ett gott självledarskap. Du håller ordning och reda, dokumenterar på en lagom nivå och bidrar till en kultur där man delar kunskap, utmanar gamla sanningar och tillsammans bygger smartare lösningar.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter:**
 Rekryterande chef: Poja Daroui, poja.daroui@agria.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Mirek Swartz, mirek.swartz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Ellinor Jatéus, ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.
   

  

 Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Despite healthcare spending at an all-time high, patient waiting time is getting longer, and patients aren’t accessing the quality of care they deserve. At Kry, we believe we can play a fundamental role in changing this. For the past ten years, we’ve been on a journey to deliver and fix healthcare, for less.
 



 As Europe’s leading digital healthcare provider and one of the largest healthcare providers in Sweden, we believe that providing accessible and affordable healthcare has never been more important. Our vision has been consistent and clear: great healthcare for everyone. Do you share our vision and want to be part of shaping the future of healthcare?
 



  





**The role** 




 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Membership and Revenue team, based in Sweden, UK or France. Together we build the systems that decide how patients get access to care, and how that care is booked, paid for and reimbursed, across every market we operate in. Our mission is to make access to care simple and reliable for patients, and to build the commercial foundations that keep Kry's care sustainable as we grow.
 



  





**What you will do** 




 Our challenge for you
 


* Design, build and own backend services and product features for our patient apps, mainly in Kotlin and Java, with some TypeScript.
* Deliver features end-to-end across multiple services, from the patient experience through to booking, payments and reimbursement.
* Help shape the technical direction of our systems, and make sure the decisions behind them are well understood and shared.
* Keep quality high through thoughtful code review and testing, and support and mentor the engineers around you.
* Work closely with product, design, data and commercial stakeholders to turn business needs into great solutions.
* Handle infrastructure and deployment pipelines with AWS, GitHub Actions and Terraform.
* Work in a lightweight, agile way. We keep adjusting our tools and ways of working so the environment stays productive and enjoyable.



  





**Who you are** 




 Your profile and skills
 


* Strong experience building backend services in Kotlin or Java.
* Experience with TypeScript and React is a plus.
* Experience using AI coding tools
* You have owned systems in production and led technical decisions within a team.
* You enjoy mentoring others and raising the quality bar through code review.
* Solid understanding of developing cloud-based applications (AWS, Terraform).
* You have experience with web and/or mobile facing clients.
* You are familiar with development tools and practices such as Git and continuous integration/delivery.
* You have experience working in agile teams.
* Experience with payments, billing or other business-critical domains is a bonus.
* You are confident working across a range of languages and frameworks and can quickly adapt to new ones.
* You want to change the healthcare system by using your passion for tech.
* You like the idea of working in a fast-moving environment.
* Comfortable working in English and French (written and verbal).



 It is not essential to have all these skills, but an aptitude and willingness to develop those you don’t know is key.
 



  





**What’s in it for you?** 



* Amazing, friendly, smart colleagues from all over the world.
* The opportunity to grow and learn from knowledgeable co-workers and cross-collaboration across departments.
* Ability to have a big impact on what we build and how we build it.
* As a team, committing to goals, sharing both success and failures.
* The chance to be a part of the journey of building the future of healthcare.
* Committed to supporting a balanced approach to work and personal life.



  





**Join us and shape your future as well as ours!** 




 If you think you’re up to the challenge, come and help us to grow, innovate and develop! A diverse workforce is an absolute necessity for anyone with a vision like ours: to provide great healthcare for everyone. Therefore we celebrate differences and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can truly belong and thrive. Our engineering team works remote-first, and we also have offices for those who enjoy spending time with colleagues in person.
 



  





**About Kry** 




 Kry is the European leader in digital healthcare, allowing patients to see a doctor, nurse, or psychologist online within minutes. We also combine digital with physical care, transforming how millions of patients access healthcare. Headquartered in Stockholm, we are committed to improving the world’s health through innovation, one patient at a time. In Sweden and Norway we are called Kry. In the UK and France, we used to operate under the name Livi, but now operate as Kry in all our markets.
 



  





**Submissions and Questions** 




 Please submit your application by including your CV or LinkedIn. No submission will be accepted via email, nor when the job posting has become inactive. All applications must go via the careers site or an official Kry job post. If you have any questions regarding jobs or our recruitment process, please read our FAQ.

title: Associate DevSecOps Engineer - based in Luxembourg
description:
**This position is based at our Luxembourg headquarters and requires regular office presence. The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi-cultural environment.** 
**We also offer relocation support.**
 The
 **EIB** 
 , the European Union's bank, is seeking to recruit for its Group Information Systems Directorate (GIS), Core Platforms & Resilience Department (CPR), Platform Engineering & Operations Division (PEO), Cloud, DevSecOps & SDLC Enablement Unit (CDSE) at its headquarters in Luxembourg, an
 **Associate DevSecOps Engineer** 
**\*.**
**This is a full-time position at grade 4 for which the EIB offers a permanent contract.**
* internal benchmark Associate Engineer IT Technology & Infrastructure


*Panel interviews are foreseen as from June 2026*
 Purpose
   

  

 The Associate DevSecOps Engineer plays a key role in embedding security into every stage of the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with experienced DevSecOps engineers as well as development, infrastructure and security teams. This role contributes to building and improving secure, automated and compliant delivery pipelines and platforms.
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to drive the adoption of DevSecOps practices across teams and support resilient CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments. It also provides hands-on exposure to vulnerability management, security monitoring and modern secure software delivery in a collaborative and evolving technology environment.
   

  

 Operating Network
   

  

 You will report to the Head of Cloud, DevSecOps & SDLC Enablement Unit (CDSE) unit and will cooperate with other platform teams in the same department as well as application teams in other departments Units, transversal teams IN Group Information Systems Directorate (GIS).
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

**DevSecOps Platform Support & Operations**
* Contribute to the operation and day‑to‑day support of the DevSecOps toolchain (e.g. CI/CD platforms, code repositories, artefact management, infrastructure‑as‑code tooling), ensuring availability, stability and secure configuration of platform components.
* Assist in the maintenance of secure CI/CD pipeline templates and shared components, applying platform standards and security baselines defined by the unit.


**SDLC Enablement & Governance Support**
* Support the rollout and adoption of the EIB SDLC framework, including the implementation of mandatory quality gates, automated controls, and evidence collection mechanisms across delivery pipelines.
* Help delivery teams understand and apply SDLC requirements by providing practical guidance, examples, and tooling support, under the supervision of senior engineers.


**Security Integration & Automation**
* Assist in embedding security controls into the DevOps lifecycle, including static and dynamic code analysis, dependency and artefact scanning, secrets management, and infrastructure security checks.
* Support the monitoring and remediation of security findings identified through automated scans, working with delivery teams and senior DevSecOps engineers to prioritise and resolve issues.


**Collaboration With Delivery Teams**
* Act as a first‑line technical contact for GIS software delivery teams on DevSecOps and SDLC platform usage, escalating complex issues where appropriate.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, platform engineers and security stakeholders to improve developer experience while maintaining compliance‑by‑design.
* Participate in communication and change management activities as an integrated aspect of IT solutions, infrastructure or processes.


**Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Management**
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of DevSecOps and SDLC practices by documenting lessons learned, updating technical documentation, and proposing incremental enhancements to tooling and processes.
* Recommend tools, technologies, and incremental improvements to overall quality and security of products infrastructure.


**Compliance, Risk & Operational Discipline**
* Apply established security, risk, and compliance requirements (including internal policies and regulatory obligations) when supporting platform components and delivery pipelines.
* Ensure that operational activities are performed in line with change, incident and problem management processes, contributing to audit readiness and traceability.


**Qualifications**
* University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor) preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
* At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in IT engineering roles related to DevOps, systems administration, cloud operations, software delivery, or security engineering.
* Basic hands‑on experience with software delivery pipelines (CI/CD) and operational environments, ideally supporting development or platform teams.
* Foundational understanding of DevSecOps principles, including “shift‑left” security and automation of controls.
* Introductory experience with cloud or virtualised environments (e.g. Azure, AWS, VMware, container platforms).
* Awareness of infrastructure‑as‑code concepts and automated provisioning, even if mainly assisting or consuming existing modules.
* Familiarity with containerisation concepts (e.g. Docker images, registries), at user level rather than platform design level.
* Basic proficiency in scripting or automation languages (e.g. Python, Bash, PowerShell), sufficient to read, adapt and troubleshoot scripts.
* Excellent knowledge of English and/or French (\*\*\*), with a good command of the other. (Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage).


 Competencies
   

  

**Find Out More About EIB Core Behavioural Skills Here**
 To find out more about our eligibility criteria click here
   

  

*(\*\*\*) Unless stated explicitly as a required qualification, a good command of French is not a pre-requisite for hire. As both English and French are however official working languages of the EIB, proficiency in both languages is a pre-requisite for your future career development. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process). Proficiency is understood to mean the attainment of* 
*level 5 of the Inter Institutional language courses, corresponding to B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL). The Bank offers appropriate training support.*
 We hire and value talent with unique characteristics, creating a work environment where they can be themselves. We believe that Diversity, Equity and Inclusion makes us a performing and innovative organisation. We encourage all suitably qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
   

  

 If you require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process due to a disability, neurodivergence, or a chronic health condition, please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will manage your request appropriately.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation.
   

  

*This is an open campaign to consecutively fill open positions. The campaign will remain open until position is filled. Applications will be reviewed in order of receipt.*

title: Senior Backend Developer | Shared Tech | 12 month FTC
description:
**Craft:**
**Job Description:**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Backend Developer** 
 to provide temporary cover within King’s Game Platform Data team. The team provides King’s telemetry platform, enabling our games to define, capture, validate, transport, and manage player-event data so it can be trusted by analytics and downstream systems.
   

  

 You will help ensure continuity across backend development, operational support, and key strategic initiatives.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who can take ownership of reliable services and integrations, collaborate closely with product and engineering partners, and make sound technical decisions in a fast-moving environment.

* Build, maintain, and improve backend services and platform capabilities that support Telemetry Data.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues; participate in operational support and improve service reliability.
* Work with engineers, data teams, product partners, and game teams to clarify requirements and deliver pragmatic solutions.
* Review code, contribute to technical design, and promote strong engineering practices for quality, observability, and maintainability.
* Document systems, decisions, and operational procedures to support effective handover and team continuity.

* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: designing maintainable services, writing high-quality code, testing, debugging, and code review.

* A strong operational mindset, including incident investigation, monitoring, and reliability improvements.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.

 Strong Java experience and familiarity with cloud-native technologies. Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka/Confluent, SQL/Big Query, or similar technologies is beneficial.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Tech Management Consultant – IT Architect
description:
Join our expanding company and help leading Swedish organizations unlock the value of technology and transform it into real business impact.
   

  

 We are a team of technology consultants with deep expertise in Tech Advisory, Tech Management and IT Architecture, helping organizations make informed and strategic technology decisions.
   

  

 We offer services in tech management & governance, IT and solution architecture, cloud optimization, core business systems and automation technologies. Our team is composed of innovative and forward-thinking professionals who are dedicated to achieving excellence, combining strong technology capabilities with a human-centric approach.
   

  

 We are looking for Tech Management Consultants with extensive experience in IT transformations and solution or enterprise architecture to join our growing team of talented architects. What unites us is the ability to use architecture as a strategic tool to help our customers maximize the value of their technology investments.
   

  

**Your Role**

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Survey & Design
description:
*10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.*
*With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.*
*Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.*
**About The Role**
 As a Full-Stack Engineer in our Survey & Design team, you'll help build the products that support some of the most important steps in Aira's customer acquisition journey.
   

  

 The team is responsible for the tools used to capture and manage information about our customers' homes, supporting everything from home surveys and technical assessments to installation design. These products help ensure that the right information is available throughout the process, enabling tailored and efficient clean energy solutions.
   

  

 You'll join a small, autonomous product team and work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and build scalable solutions that support Aira's continued growth across Europe.
   

  

 As a Full-Stack Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping the products and services that power these workflows. You'll work across the stack to build scalable solutions and great user experiences.
   

  

***In this role, you will***
* Design and build applications and services that support users across multiple European markets
* Develop scalable APIs and integrations with third-party systems
* Process and manage data collected throughout the Survey & Design journey
* Transform complex technical and geometric data into solutions that support our products and workflows
* Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term evolution of the platform
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and end users to improve workflows, user experiences and product capabilities
* Explore new technologies and approaches that help solve real business problems


 We're making home energy design smarter, simpler and more scalable. If you enjoy building great products and solving complex problems in a technically challenging domain, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* Around 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* Experience building modern software applications across different parts of the stack
* Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot
* Experience designing and building APIs
* A solid understanding of databases, software architecture and distributed systems
* Experience working with microservices
* The ability to turn ideas into clean, testable and scalable software
* A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership
* Strong collaboration and communication skills


 We believe you'll thrive in this role if you're curious, analytical and enjoy understanding the real-world challenges behind the software you build. You don't need a background in engineering, but an interest in technical domains and complex problem-solving will help you succeed.
   

  

 We're also looking for someone who enjoys learning new technologies and is curious about how emerging technologies, including AI, can create value for both products and ways of working.
   

  

*Our tech stack:*
 Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, gRPC, Kotlin, Python, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Kubernetes and Docker.
   

  

***What is in it for you?***
* Join a mission-driven company accelerating the transition to clean energy across Europe
* Work on products that have a direct impact on how clean energy solutions are designed and delivered
* Be part of a small, highly autonomous team with significant influence on product and technical decisions
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across product, engineering and operations
* Grow professionally in a fast-moving and international environment
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Software Test Development Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Coherent Corp is the global leader in photonics, designing and manufacturing advanced laser, optical, and materials technologies. Our innovations power semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications, and precision industrial systems worldwide. With a global footprint and cutting-edge manufacturing and R&D, we’re shaping the future of high-tech industries.
   

  

**Software Test Development Engineer**
 This is a hands-on software engineering role within an R&D environment, focused on building, maintaining and adapting the software infrastructure required to communicate with and control instrumentation for optical component testing. Your work will support early-stage R&D testing and the development of reliable, automated test solutions for use throughout component development and manufacturing. In the role, you will work closely with on-site teams across Chip Design, Wafer Fabrication, Process Engineering, Operations, Quality & Reliability, Verification, and Project Management.
   

  

 What you will be doing...
   

  

* Contribute to the design and planning of new test setups, with a focus on software for component control, characterisation, and verification.
* Develop and maintain software used to control instruments and devices, collect measurements, and process test data.
* Support the development and validation of algorithms that automate component control and characterisation activities
* Help ensure test processes are robust, reliable, and suitable for use during both development and manufacturing.
* Review, improve, and support the formal release of test software updates in response to: Changes to product or test specifications Changes to software and/or algorithm requirements Bug fixes Deployment of test solutions to new sites Test-time reduction initiatives
* Analyse measurement data to verify test quality and assist with troubleshooting and root-cause investigations.
* Work with engineering, verification, and manufacturing colleagues during new product development and the transition into production.
* Create and maintain clear documentation for test software, algorithms, and related projects.
* Participate in knowledge sharing with other team members on topics such as software development practices, library reuse, and optical component characteristics.


**About You**
* An MSc or PhD in Software Engineering, Optoelectronics, Electronics, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline Up to five years [NR1] of relevant professional experience.
* Knowledge of object-oriented programming, ideally using C#, C++, or Java.
* Experience with test systems, scientific equipment, or similar technical or lab/production environments.
* Experience with Python or MATLAB.
* Experience with data analysis, modelling, simulation, algorithm development, or measurement processing would be an advantage.
* Experience or knowledge of semiconductor/optoelectronic devices, electronics, industrial automation, or manufacturing test environments [NR2] .
* Comfortable collaborating with colleagues from different technical disciplines and sharing knowledge within a team.


 Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:

 ntegrity – Create an Environment of Trust

 ollaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

 ccountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

 espect – Recognize the Value in Everyone
   

  

**E** 
 nthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

 If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to
 **Alyxandra.Highland@coherent.com** 
 . We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.
   

  

**About Us**
 Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!

title: Affärsanalytiker Retail
description:
Evidensia är en del av Europas ledande veterinärkedja och möter varje år i Sverige över 600 000 djurbesök, och bakom nästan varje klinik finns en butiksverksamhet. Vi söker nu en affärsanalytiker som vill ta ett brett grepp om vår retailaffär, med fokus på analysteman så som sortiment, pris, marginal och lager.


Du blir nyckelpersonen för retail i vårt etablerade Data & Analytics-team. Rollen är både operativ och analytisk: du arbetar löpande i vårt PMS (Practice Management System) Provet Cloud med artikellistor, priser och lager, samtidigt som du äger business case, ad hoc-analyser och uppföljning i Power BI och Excel. Allt detta görs i nära samarbete med vår butiksansvariga, inköp, marknad, kliniker och ledningsgrupp.

#### **Vad du kommer att göra**

* Driva affärsanalysen för butiksverksamheten genom business case, ad hoc-analyser och löpande uppföljning i Power BI
* Ta fram beslutsunderlag för till exempel sortiment och lagerstyrning
* Löpande analysera försäljning, marginaler, lager och sortiment
* Förvalta artikellistor, prisstruktur och lagermodulen i Provet Cloud
* Delta i planering och uppföljning av butikskampanjer
* Ge löpande och lösningsorienterad support till klinikerna
* Omsätta analys och idéer till praktiska förbättringar i verksamheten

#### **Vem vi söker**


Vi söker framför allt en lösningsorienterad och handlingskraftig person som tycker om att få saker att fungera i praktiken. Du behöver inte alltid ha en färdig lösning från början, men du är nyfiken, testar dig fram och hittar pragmatiska vägar framåt – även när data, system eller processer inte är perfekta.


Du är positiv, prestigelös och trygg i att fatta rimliga beslut utifrån den information som finns. Samtidigt tar du ansvar för hela processen: från att identifiera ett problem och analysera orsaken till att föreslå, genomföra och följa upp en lösning. En del i det är att växla mellan analys, systemarbete, problemlösning och kontakt med klinikerna utan att tappa struktur eller framdrift.

#### **Vi tror att du har:**

* Erfarenhet av retail, inköp, lagerstyrning eller liknande verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta obehindrat i Excel och Power BI
* Förmåga att omsätta data och verksamhetsbehov till enkla, fungerande lösningar
* Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förmåga att driva flera frågor framåt samtidigt
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift
* Det är dessutom meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att automatisera repetitiva uppgifter, till exempel i Python eller Power Automate

#### **Vad vi erbjuder**

* Ett företag som är datadrivet på djupet, inte bara i ord
* Ett etablerat team med dataingenjör, BI-utvecklare och affärsanalytiker som lägger en stark analytisk grund, med hög kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och en kultur där nyfikenhet och eget ansvar uppskattas
* Arbete i Microsofts dataekosystem
* Rollen utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Gärdet i Stockholm, med möjlighet att över tid röra sig mot ett hybridupplägg på ca 3 dagar/vecka på kontoret
* Lön enligt överenskommelse, marknadsmässig

#### **Ansökan**


Låter det här som en roll för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan i dag. Vi går igenom ansökningar och genomför intervjuer löpande.

**Har du frågor om rollen?**  

Kontakta Emelia Johansson, Head of Data & Analytics Northern Europe  

emelia.johansson@evidensia.se · 070-08 58 490

Do you want to build a cloud platform that helps keep medicines safe on their way to patients around the world? At TSS, you will help develop technology used by leading pharmaceutical companies worldwide to monitor temperature-sensitive medicines throughout the supply chain. You will also play a central role as TSS takes the next step from on-prem to Azure. About the role As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will be part of TSS's Cloud Platform team, which builds and runs the platform that TSS's applications and connected products rely on.
  
  

You will design, build and operate the platform, and take an active part in technology decisions and the technical roadmap. The platform is a product in itself. Your job is to make it easy for the application teams to build, deploy, and run their services in a secure, compliant, and reliable way. TSS operates in a regulated environment (GxP), where traceability and quality are part of everyday work.
  
  

You will help turn compliance requirements into practical technical controls, without making them heavier than they need to be. You will, among other things: Take part in migrating TSS's on-prem/private cloud environments to Azure, including the IoT cloud that serves a global fleet of around 8,000 gateways. Build and operate the Kubernetes (AKS) platform, including cluster lifecycle, ingress, service mesh, certificates and secrets. Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform and Terragrunt, and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions and GitOps.
  
  

Standardize deployment patterns and create templates and golden paths for the development teams. Set up monitoring and observability and take part in operations and incident handling. You will work closely with the application teams and the IoT team. TSS is a small organization with short decision paths, so you will have real influence and be expected to take your own initiatives.
  
  

The role is based at TSS's office in Solna, with a hybrid setup where the team typically works from the office 2 days per week. About you We are looking for a senior engineer with solid experience in building and running cloud platforms in production. You enjoy working close to developers, you have a pragmatic mindset, and you like driving standardization and automation. We believe you have: At least 5 years of experience in cloud or platform engineering.
  
  

At least 3 years of experience running containers in production, preferably with Kubernetes. Experience designing and building platforms, not just using them. Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and with CI/CD and GitOps pipelines. Good knowledge of Linux, networking, and monitoring of cloud services.
  
  

A master's degree in a relevant technical field. Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken. Experience with Azure (AKS, Azure Policy, Container Apps), MySQL, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, service mesh and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry is a plus. We also value experience of DevSecOps, supply chain security or incident management, as well as a background in MedTech, pharma or other GxP-regulated environments.

title: Graphic Designer, vikariat
description:
**Graphic Designer till Naturkompaniet**
----------------------------------------

**Ort**: Stockholm | **Omfattning**: 100% | **Anställningsform:** Vikariat, 12 månader med chans till förlängning | **Start**: Enligt överenskommelse | **Sista ansökningsdag**: 2026-10-18

### **Varför vi finns och hur vi jobbar**


Hela grunden till vår existens bygger på vår passion för friluftsliv. Vi vill göra vardagen till ett äventyr - oavsett om det handlar om att plocka svamp runt husknuten eller att bestiga berg i Sarek.  

  

Naturkompaniet är en del av Fenix Outdoor, en internationell koncern med stark förankring i natur och friluftsliv. På Naturkompaniet arbetar vi nära varandra i en platt organisation där idéer får komma från många håll och där vi når våra mål tillsammans. Vi tror på att gå vår egen väg, vara kostnadsmedvetna och fatta genomtänkta beslut. Vårt engagemang för natur, friluftsliv och hållbara val ska genomsyra det vi gör.


Nu söker vi en **Graphic Designer** till vår marknadsavdelning i centrala Stockholm.

### **Om avdelningen**


Marknadsavdelningen består av åtta personer som arbetar med Naturkompaniets varumärke, kampanjer och marknadsföring.


En stor del av vår marknadsföring skapas inhouse. Det innebär att vi arbetar tillsammans hela vägen från strategi och kreativ idé till produktion och färdig kommunikation i våra olika kanaler – bland annat butik, digitala kanaler, köpt media och vårt magasin 365.


Vi är ett team med olika kompetenser som arbetar tätt tillsammans och värdesätter både hantverket och teamkänslan. Gemensamt för oss är vår mission: att dela med oss av vår erfarenhet och passion för friluftsliv. Vi värnar om miljön, inspirerar och utrustar människor för att spendera tid i naturen.

### **Din roll**


Som Graphic Designer är du en viktig del av Naturkompaniets kreativa arbete. Tillsammans med vår Art Director och övriga kollegor utvecklar och producerar du kommunikation som stärker Naturkompaniets varumärke och skapar en tydlig och sammanhållen upplevelse ut mot kund.


Du är trygg i ditt grafiska hantverk och kan självständigt ta ett uppdrag från brief och idé till färdig produkt.

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**

* Skapa och utveckla kampanjmaterial för butik, digitala kanaler, köpt media och sociala medier
* Arbeta med produktion av material för både digitala och tryckta kanaler
* Skapa material för POS, annonser, CRM, webb, sociala medier och intern kommunikation
* Arbeta med layout och grafisk produktion för bland annat magasin 365
* Omsätta kreativa idéer och koncept till stark visuell kommunikation
* Säkerställa att Naturkompaniets grafiska identitet och riktlinjer följs och utvecklas i vår kommunikation
* Samarbeta med Art Director, marknadsförare, e-commerce, butiksorganisation och andra delar av verksamheten
* Vid behov medverka i planering och genomförande av foto- och innehållsproduktioner
* Bidra med idéer, perspektiv och grafisk kompetens i marknadsteamets löpande arbete.
  

Det här är med andra ord inte en roll där du enbart tar emot färdiga originaluppdrag. Vi söker dig som både uppskattar själva hantverket och vill vara med och tänka kring hur Naturkompaniet ska kommunicera visuellt.

### **Om den vi söker**


För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du är en skicklig grafisk designer med ett starkt visuellt öga och känsla för typografi, färg, bild och komposition.


Du kan växla mellan idéarbete och produktion och är bekväm med att hantera flera uppdrag parallellt. Du är noggrann och håller deadlines, men förstår också när det är värt att utmana en brief eller föreslå en bättre lösning.


Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra är det viktigt att du gillar samarbete, är prestigelös och kan både ge och ta emot feedback.


Vi tror också att natur och friluftsliv väcker ett genuint intresse hos dig. Du kan redan mycket om produkterna i vårt sortiment och har en nyfikenhet på den värld Naturkompaniet verkar i och en vilja att förstå våra kunder och produkter.  

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**

* Minst 5 års relevant erfarenhet som grafisk designer eller från en liknande kreativ roll, exempelvis på en inhouseavdelning, byrå eller inom retail

* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom grafisk design, visuell kommunikation eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt InDesign, Photoshop och Illustrator samt andra relevanta programvaror
* Gedigen erfarenhet av grafisk produktion för både digitala och tryckta kanaler
* God förståelse för varumärkesutveckling och förmåga att arbeta konsekvent utifrån en grafisk identitet
* Förmåga att självständigt driva grafiska uppdrag från brief till färdig leverans
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
* Kunskap och intresse för friluftsliv och produkter i Naturkompaniets sortiment.
  

Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet eller kunskap inom exempelvis fotografi, film, motion design eller annan rörlig kommunikation.

  

Din personliga lämplighet värdesätts högt i rekryteringsprocessen.

**Som person tror vi att du är:**


Kreativ och nyfiken, men också strukturerad och pålitlig. Du har känsla för design, färg, bild och aktuella visuella uttryck utan att låta trender gå före varumärket.


Du tar initiativ och ansvar för ditt arbete, tycker om att samarbeta och bidrar till teamet med både idéer och ett gott arbetsklimat. Du är prestigelös, lösningsorienterad och mån om kvalitet – även när tempot är högt. Och framför allt delar du vår nyfikenhet på naturen och livet utomhus.

### **Mer om tjänsten och ansökan**


Tjänsten är ett tidsbegränsat vikariat, på 12 månader med chans till förlängning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är placerad på Naturkompaniets huvudkontor i Stockholm. Vi tillämpar en hybrid arbetsform med möjlighet till en dag distansarbete per vecka.  

  

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-18.


Naturkompaniet är anslutna till kollektivavtal vilket innebär att våra medarbetare täcks av trygga villkor, tjänstepension och försäkringar. Vi erbjuder flera förmåner som personalrabatt, friskvårdsbidrag, tillgång till låneutrustning till ditt friluftsäventyr och samarbete med lokala gym till förmånliga priser.


Naturkompaniet strävar ständigt efter att skapa och främja en mångsidig och inkluderande arbetsplats för alla medarbetare. Vi erbjuder lika möjligheter till anställning och har som mål att skapa en trygg, rättvis och vänlig arbetsmiljö där alla känner sig välkomna och kan trivas.  

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan och portfolio!**

title: Thesis worker 30 hp - Efficient Vehicle-to-Cloud Telemetry over MQTT
description:
**30 hp – Efficient Vehicle-to-Cloud Telemetry over MQTT: Evaluating XCP-Based Data Transport and Predictive Compression**

  

**Introduction**  

  



Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project.

  

TRATON GROUP is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers, with brands including Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. Its portfolio covers light commercial vehicles, trucks and buses, complemented by financing, charging and digital logistics services. Through its global operations, production sites and extensive sales and service networks, TRATON has access to diverse vehicle platforms, real-world operational data and fleet deployment environments. This provides a strong foundation for developing and validating innovative solutions for sustainable and efficient transportation.


In the Cloud and Embedded Platform domain within TRATON, we develop new solutions for connected vehicles in our Internet of Things (IoT) platform, as part of TRATON’s increasing focus on communication, services and smart transport solutions.  

  



**Background**  

  



Connected vehicles continuously generate measurement and diagnostic data that can support fleet services, vehicle development, maintenance, and cloud-based analytics. Transmitting this data from vehicles to cloud services over mobile networks introduces several challenges, including limited bandwidth, variable connectivity, communication cost, latency, and processing constraints in the vehicle.


A typical data path begins with signals collected inside the vehicle. These signals must be extracted, encoded, transported through an onboard communication client, transmitted over the air, and reconstructed by a cloud-side receiver. The efficiency of this complete pipeline depends not only on the compression algorithm, but also on the data representation, protocol overhead, message structure, reliability mechanisms, and computational cost.


Within the vehicle, standardization is important because the data originates from heterogeneous embedded systems. XCP is therefore a relevant candidate for representing and accessing measurement data on the vehicle side. However, the data must still be transported efficiently between the vehicle and the cloud. MQTT is a suitable candidate for this offboard communication because it is lightweight, widely supported, and designed for unreliable or bandwidth-constrained networks.


This thesis will investigate how an efficient vehicle-to-cloud telemetry model can be designed by combining a standardized onboard data representation with an MQTT-based over-the-air transport layer.

  

**Objective**  

  



The aim of this thesis is to design and evaluate an efficient vehicle-to-cloud telemetry pipeline in which measurement data is collected using a standardized vehicle-side interface and transmitted over MQTT to a cloud-side receiver.


The thesis will investigate how different encoding, batching, compression, and prediction strategies affect the overall efficiency of the communication path. The evaluation will consider not only compression ratio, but also bandwidth usage, latency, computational cost, memory consumption, reliability, and preservation of data accuracy.

  

  

**Main research question**  

  



**How can vehicle measurement data be transported from an onboard client to a cloud receiver over MQTT with minimal bandwidth and latency while maintaining acceptable computational complexity and data fidelity?**

  

  

  

**Research questions**  

  



**RQ1** – End-to-end efficiency


How do different data representations and transport strategies affect the total size and performance of vehicle-to-cloud telemetry over MQTT?


**RQ2** – Role of standardization


How can XCP-based measurement data be integrated into an MQTT-based vehicle-to-cloud communication model, and what protocol overhead does this introduce?


**RQ3** – Compression and prediction


Can signal-aware encoding, delta coding, or lightweight predictive models reduce bandwidth usage compared with conventional JSON, Protocol Buffers, and generic compression methods?


**If time allows**


**RQ4** – System trade-offs


What are the trade-offs between bandwidth reduction, latency, CPU usage, memory consumption, implementation complexity, and reconstruction accuracy?


If time permits:


**RQ5** – Impact on cloud analytics


Does compression and reconstruction affect the performance of a downstream cloud analytics task, such as anomaly detection?

  

  

  

**Education/line/direction**  

  



Masters programmes in Computer Science, Electrical Engineer, or equivalent.


Number of students: 1


Start date for the Thesis project: Spring 2027


Estimated timescale: 20 weeks

title: MSc Thesis - Forensically sound logging for connected vehicles
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

 **Background of thesis work**


Safety is a major concern in the transportation sector, and cybersecurity is a vital prerequisite to ensure it, especially in the age of connected vehicles. As vehicles become increasingly interconnected with backend services and external infrastructure, the likelihood and potential impact of cybersecurity incidents increase. When such incidents occur, reliable forensic evidence is needed to understand what happened, determine the origin and sequence of events, and support further investigation.

  

Vehicle and backend logs can provide important forensic evidence. However, conventional logging mechanisms do not necessarily guarantee that the collected information is authentic, complete, traceable, or protected against manipulation. Evidence may pass through several components and communication links before reaching a backend system. During this process, an attacker may attempt to modify, delete, insert, replay, or reorder log records. Intermittent connectivity, clock differences, component failures, and limited vehicle resources introduce additional challenges.

  

Forensically sound logging therefore requires mechanisms that preserve properties such as integrity, authenticity, provenance, event ordering, freshness, and chain of custody. The protocol should also consider confidentiality, privacy, availability, communication overhead, and the constraints of embedded vehicle systems. Approaches from automotive cybersecurity, digital forensics, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and embedded systems address parts of this problem, but further research is needed to determine how they can be combined into a protocol suitable for connected vehicles.

  

For this thesis, the focus is on designing an OEM- and hardware-agnostic logging protocol for the secure collection and preservation of forensic evidence from connected vehicles to backend systems. The work will investigate which forensic and security properties the protocol should provide, how provenance and chain of custody can be represented, and how selected properties can be formally specified and verified. A proof-of-concept demonstrator will be developed and evaluated against representative threats, failure scenarios, and performance requirements.

Other relevant courses include AI/ML, distributed systems, logic, and similar courses.

After a successful thesis project, students will gain experience in the field of automotive E/E system development, and security design. Students will also have an opportunity to gain insights into how research is conducted in the automotive industry.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. title: Cloud & Infra Arkitekt
description:
Jobba för originalet.
   

  

 Välkommen till Apoteket, nummer ett sedan 1971. Med visioner för framtiden och kvalitet i varje detalj, skapar vi förutsättningar för ett liv i hälsa. Hos oss utvecklas du i en kultur där din röst alltid blir hörd. Och allt vi får över ger vi tillbaka till samhället. Det är så vi gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

 Om Enterprisearkitektur på Apoteket
   

  

 Vårt uppdrag är att hitta de bästa och mest hållbara lösningarna utifrån verksamhetens behov och det systemlandskap vi har idag. Det innebär att väga samman allt från tekniska möjligheter och befintliga lösningar till IT-säkerhet, legala krav och långsiktiga behov – och hitta en väg framåt som fungerar för Apoteket som helhet.
   

  

 Arkitektur skapas inte på egen hand, därför är samarbete en viktig del av vår vardag och vi arbetar nära både verksamheten och olika delar av Tech för att förstå behov, utmana perspektiv och tillsammans fatta välgrundade beslut.
   

  

 Samtidigt utvecklar vi hela tiden hur vi arbetar med arkitektur på Apoteket. Vi delar kunskap, skapar gemensamma arbetssätt och gör arkitektur mer tillgängligt i organisationen. Här får du möjlighet att både bidra med din egen specialistkompetens och vara med och påverka hur Apotekets arkitektur utvecklas framåt.
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet Enterprisearkitektur, där du tillsammans med nio kollegor med kompetens inom lösningsarkitektur, informationsarkitektur, infrastruktur och moln är med och formar Apotekets framtida IT-landskap.
   

  

 Din roll
   

  

 Som Cloud & Infrastruktur Arkitekt har du en central roll i att forma och utveckla Apotekets framtida drift- och infrastrukturmiljöer. Du arbetar rådgivande och nära produktledare, systemarkitekter, lösningsarkitekter och tekniska specialister för att säkerställa att våra lösningar är skalbara, säkra, kostnadseffektiva och anpassade efter verksamhetens behov.
   

  

 I rollen analyserar och designar du lösningar för både cloud-, on-premises- och hybridmiljöer. Du ansvarar för att omsätta verksamhetskrav, tekniska förutsättningar och säkerhetskrav till genomtänkta arkitekturlösningar och konkreta designval.
   

  

 Du arbetar iterativt med lösningsdesign och tar hänsyn till bland annat kapacitet, nätverk, drift, återställning, övervakning och teknisk säkerhet. Lösningarna valideras löpande tillsammans med relevanta intressenter och anpassas för att skapa rätt balans mellan funktion, säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnad.
   

  

 Vad du kommer göra hos oss:
   

  

* Agera rådgivare inom moln- och on-premises-lösningar med särskilt fokus på Microsoft Azure
* Analysera och designa driftmiljöer för cloud-, hybrid- och on-premises-lösningar
* Omsätta verksamhetskrav och tekniska behov till skalbara och hållbara arkitekturlösningar
* Validera och kalibrera krav på SLA, kapacitet, tillgänglighet och prestanda
* Designa lösningar för bland annat nätverk, drift, säkerhetskopiering och återställning
* Identifiera behov inom incidenter, övervakning och tekniska säkerhetsåtgärder
* Säkerställa att lösningar möter Apotekets krav på säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet
* Samarbeta nära arkitekter, tekniska specialister, produktorganisation och andra intressenter
* Bidra till tekniska vägval, principer och arbetssätt för Apotekets framtida infrastruktur
* Följa utvecklingen inom cloud och infrastruktur och bidra med nya perspektiv och lösningar


 Vem söker vi?
   

  

 För den här rollen söker vi dig som har en gedigen teknisk bakgrund inom infrastruktur och cloud och som trivs i en roll där du kombinerar djup teknisk kompetens med ett brett helhetsperspektiv.
   

  

 Du är van att arbeta med komplexa tekniska miljöer och har förmågan att se hur olika delar inom infrastruktur, cloud, nätverk, säkerhet och drift hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du arbetar strukturerat och analytiskt och kan omsätta komplexa behov till tydliga och genomförbara lösningar.
   

  

 Samtidigt är du kommunikativ och trygg i att samarbeta med olika typer av intressenter. Du kan anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagare och är bekväm med att både utmana befintliga lösningar och argumentera för tekniska vägval.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och vågar utforska nya angreppssätt när det behövs för att hitta hållbara och effektiva lösningar.
   

  

 Vi ser att du har:
   

  

* Du har akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande
* Du har erfarenhet av att analysera och designa drift- och infrastrukturmiljöer inom on-premises, cloud och hybrid.
* Du har erfarenhet som Cloud arkitekt eller motsvarande roll med fokus på Microsoft Azure
* Djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure och god förståelse för moderna cloud-arkitekturer
* Bred teknisk kompetens inom on-premises-infrastruktur och hybridmiljöer
* Du har erfarenhet av att designa skalbara, säkra och kostnadseffektiva infrastrukturlösningar
* Erfarenhet av områden som nätverk, drift, återställning, teknisk säkerhet och övervakning
* God förståelse för teknisk säkerhet och hur säkerhetskrav omsätts i arkitektur och lösningsdesign
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa miljöer med många tekniska beroenden och intressenter
* Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska & engelska i tal och skrift


**Vi erbjuder...**
* Friskvårdsbidrag: 5000 kr per år.
* Personalrabatt: Förmånliga priser på många av våra produkter.
* Flexibla helgdagar: Möjlighet att byta arbetsfria helgdagar mot andra dagar på året.
* Förmånsportal (Benifex): Erbjudanden inom bland annat kollektivtrafik, leasingbil, gym och hälsobehandlingar.
* Trygga försäkringar: Förstärkt föräldrapenning, tjänstepension (ITP) och kompletterande försäkringar.


**Om oss**
 Apoteket grundades 1971 och ägs av svenska staten, vilket innebär att vi arbetar både ansvarsfullt och långsiktigt. Vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag handlar om att förbättra människors hälsa, läkemedelsanvändning och bidra till ökad patientsäkerhet. Med omkring 400 apotek och 3000 medarbetare över hela landet har vi nära samarbete med hälso- och sjukvården – alltid med omtanke om både människor och miljö.
   

  

 Vårt mål är tydligt: Ett liv i hälsa, för alla.
   

  

  

**Praktisk information**
 Nyfiken? Det räcker gott.
   

  

 Hör av dig om rollen fångar ditt intresse! Vi berättar gärna mer om tjänsten och vår verksamhet – så du får en tydligare bild och kan avgöra om det känns helt rätt. Vänta bara inte för länge, urval och intervju sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
   

  

 Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med svar på våra urvalsfrågor. Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev – frågorna är utformade för att hjälpa oss förstå mer om dina erfarenheter och kompetenser för matchning mot tjänst.
   

  

 Vi använder tester för objektivt urval som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Provanställning tillämpas.
   

  

 Välkommen till Apoteket!

 Du har byggt agenter som används av verkliga användare och vet att produktionssatta lösningar behöver följas upp, förbättras och förvaltas. Du kombinerar teknisk höjd med verksamhetsförståelse och kan förklara komplexa vägval på ett tydligt sätt.
   

  

 Du arbetar självständigt i kunduppdrag, är trygg med att leda workshops och vågar rekommendera ett annat angreppssätt när det ger bättre effekt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.

 Erfarenhet av Copilot Studio i produktion är ett krav. Övriga kvalifikationer kan vägas upp av annan relevant erfarenhet.

* ALM i Power Platform, inklusive lösningar, pipelines, miljöer och versionshantering.
* Erfarenhet av att utbilda eller coacha verksamhetsnära utvecklare i Copilot Studio och Power Platform.
* Förståelse för prismodeller, tokenekonomi, FinOps och kostnadsoptimering av AI- och agentlösningar.
* Utrullning och styrning av Microsoft 365 Copilot i större organisationer.
* Relevanta certifieringar inom Microsoft eller Google Cloud.


**Rollen och uppdraget**
* Uppdrag där lösningar går från idé till produktion och långsiktig förvaltning.
* En kombination av teknisk specialist, lösningsarkitekt, rådgivare och utbildare.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerade agentlösningar över flera tekniska plattformar.
* Inflytande över hur vi utvecklar Forefronts erbjudande och arbetssätt inom agentisk AI.


 Du blir en del av vårt Productivity & Collaboration-team, där du arbetar nära andra specialister inom digital arbetsplats och AI. Runt dig finns också kollegor inom Data & Analytics, Cloud & Security och andra kompetensområden. Tillsammans kan vi ta helhetsansvar när en lösning berör exempelvis data, identitet, behörigheter, integrationer eller molnarkitektur.
   

  

**Vi lovar dig!**

**Om Forefront Group**
 Forefront Group är din partner för affärsdrivande transformation. Vi vet att teknik skapar möjligheter och människor skapar förändring. Sedan 2008 förenar vi djup teknisk kunskap med strategisk höjd för att skapa hållbar förflyttning för våra kunder. Våra kunder ger oss ett NPS på 97. title: Senior Application Support Consultant
description:
Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.
   

  





 With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.
   

  





 At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose:
 **Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters** 
 . — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.
   

  





 We’re shaping
 **how work should feel** 
 , and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Application Support Consultant** 
 to join our team, supporting customers across the EMEA regions on the Unit4 ERP platform.
   

  





 This is a senior, hands-on role. You will play a key role in stablising and strengthening a team that has undergone recent changes, ensuring high-quality support delivery while mentoring colleagues and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  





 Alongside managing complex support cases and escalations, you will help develop team capability through
 **knowledge sharing, training, and coaching** 
 , while also gaining exposure to both
 **Unit4 ERP and ERPx** 
 through structured learning opportunities.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Manage and resolve
 **daily incoming customer support cases** 
 across EMEA and UK regions


* Act as a
 **subject matter expert** 
 for complex issues and escalations


* Provide
 **guidance and mentoring** 
 to team members as required


* Deliver
 **training sessions** 
 and support knowledge development within the team


* Take ownership of
 **escalation management** 
 , ensuring timely and effective resolution


* Operate within a
 **flat team structure** 
 , covering both first-line and advanced support responsibilities


* Balance
 **operational support delivery** 
 with
 **strategic contributions** 
 such as mentoring and process improvement


* Contribute to
 **special projects and process improvements**


* Work across both
 **Unit4 ERP and ERPx** 
 , starting with ERP and expanding knowledge via a rotation programme


**Qualifications**

**Must-Have**



* Proven experience with
 **Unit4 ERP/x** 
 (essential)


* Strong knowledge of the
 **Financial/Logistics module**


* **Basic SQL skills** 
 (querying, troubleshooting)


* Strong
 **English communication skills** 
 (written and verbal)


* Ability to manage
 **both standard support cases and complex escalations**


* Occassional travel to customer sites where required
