**Nice-to-Have**



* Advanced SQL knowledge


* Experience in mentoring or coaching colleagues


* Training delivery experience

**Additional Information**

**Who we are?**




 We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.
   

  





 We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.
   

  





 We are reimagining how work makes people feel.
   

  





**What we offer?**



* a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
* balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
* growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
* talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
* a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme

**Our commitment to equity**




 Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

* Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!*

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Anti-Cheat
description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.
   

  

 We are now looking for a well rounded Senior Backend engineer with front-end experience to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for maintaining and developing the services that power Embark’s anti-cheat activities, and develop tools and visualizations within our internal web portals supporting both our own and other teams at Embark.
   

  

 You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You enjoy applying the full breadth of your skill set to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.
   

  

**Example Of Responsibilities**
* Operate, monitor and develop anti-cheat services critical to our live games
* Design and deploy internal services supporting the anti-cheat operation
* Work with internal users to design and develop web tools and visualizations


**We would love if you have**
* A creative and curious mind
* Proficiency in Go
* Proficiency in Typescript
* Experience in developing and operating distributed systems
* Experience in developing intuitive, easy-to-use, graphical interfaces
* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
* Professional English communication skills
* Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!


 At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
   

  

 We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.
   

  

 Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.
   

  

 Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Drive the strategy of our strategic e-commerce platform and shape the future of connected commerce.**
**Senior Product Manager - Vendre (M/F)**
 Join Orisha's Product team and take full ownership of
 **Vendre** 
 , our strategic e-commerce platform.
   

  

 As Senior Product Manager, you will work in close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.
   

  

 Your role centres around two key dimensions: evolving the Vendre platform (notably through AI integration and agentic commerce) and driving the seamless migration of our clients to this future-proof solution.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**1/ Evolve and strengthen the Vendre platform**
* Vision & Roadmap: Define and champion the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Vendre.
* Market Analysis & Customer Needs: Develop a deep understanding of customers, users, competitors, and market trends across B2B, B2C, and omnichannel commerce use cases.
* AI Integration & Agentic Commerce: Define how AI and agentic commerce should be integrated into the Vendre experience, identifying and validating AI-enabled features, copilots, and autonomous commerce workflows.
* Arbitration & Commercial Performance: Balance customer value, growth opportunities, platform modernisation, and technical debt to maximise adoption, retention, and commercial performance.


**2/ Drive platform migration to Vendre**
* Migration Strategy: Define the product strategy for migrating customers from legacy platforms to Vendre.
* Segmentation & Trajectories: Segment the installed base, establish clear migration waves and priorities, and build repeatable migration journeys alongside Engineering, Customer Success, Services, and Sales.
* Functional Gap Resolution: Identify functional gaps blocking migration and prioritize the capabilities required to strengthen the standard platform without recreating legacy complexity.
* Legacy Management & Performance Tracking: Decide which legacy capabilities should be rebuilt, redesigned, replaced, integrated, or retired, while tracking migration progress, customer adoption, transferred revenue, and churn risk.


**About You**
* Strong product management experience in SaaS, e-commerce, or B2B / Enterprise software.
* Proven ability to own a product strategy and a complex roadmap, supported by strong customer discovery, prioritization, and analytical skills.
* Good understanding of AI product development and opportunities related to agentic commerce.
* Experience enhancing an established platform; background in platform migration or product consolidation is a major plus.
* Commercial mindset, with the ability to connect product decisions directly to business outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent in English (both written and spoken).


***At Orisha, AI is a daily ally: we encourage and train every employee to use Gemini to boost their creativity and productivity.***
 ➡️ This position is available on a permanent contract (CDI) and based in Saltmätargatan 5, 113 59 Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**About Orisha** 
 Founded in 2003, Orisha is a European software publisher dedicated primarily to retail, real estate, healthcare, construction, and agrifood companies. Since its creation, Orisha has guided companies toward success by offering industry-specific solutions essential to their daily operations. Orisha generates over €350M in revenue and has more than 2,200 employees. Orisha supports over 50,000 customers across +100 countries with their daily operational technology needs.

title: Examensarbete: Koldioxidmedvetna beslut inom molnarkitektur
description:
**Övergripande beskrivning**
 Detta examensarbete syftar till att undersöka om beslut inom molnarkitektur kan utvärderas utifrån deras uppskattade klimatpåverkan, och inte bara utifrån kostnad och prestanda. Hållbarhet blir en allt viktigare faktor inom molnutveckling, men de klimatrapporter som molnleverantörer erbjuder är oftast sammanställda på konto- eller organisationsnivå. De ger därför litet stöd när enskilda arkitekturval ska utvärderas. Arbetet ska utforska om mätningar på resursnivå och befintliga metoder för koldioxidberäkning kan ge mer användbara insikter på arkitekturnivå.
   

  

**Projektbeskrivning**
 Projektet kommer att innebära att implementera och prestandatesta två eller flera alternativa molnarkitekturer för en representativ arbetslast. Det kan exempelvis handla om att jämföra en serverlös arkitektur med en containerbaserad lösning. Arkitekturerna utvärderas under kontrollerade förhållanden utifrån mått som kostnad, latens och genomströmning. Studenten har stort utrymme att själv välja arkitekturer, arbetslast, metoder och avgränsningar.
   

  

 Forskningen kommer att fokusera på hur insamlad data om resursanvändning och prestanda kan användas för att uppskatta arkitekturernas klimatpåverkan. Studenten undersöker tillgängliga metoder för koldioxidberäkning, exempelvis befintliga verktyg, data från molnleverantörer, resursbaserade modeller eller en kombination av dessa. Där det är lämpligt kan uppskattningarna även jämföras med molnleverantörernas egen klimatrapportering. En viktig del av arbetet är att bedöma metodens tillförlitlighet, osäkerhet och reproducerbarhet. Målet är inte nödvändigtvis att mäta utsläppen exakt, utan att avgöra om uppskattningarna ger tillräckligt användbar information för att stödja verkliga arkitekturbeslut.
   

  

**Vem söker vi?**
* Masterutbildning inom datateknik, datavetenskap, teknisk fysik eller närliggande område
* Inriktning mot molnbaserad utveckling, mjukvaruarkitektur eller dataanalys är meriterande
* Examen i juni 2027
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
* Flytande engelska i tal och skrift


**Syfte**
 Syftet med examensarbetet är att undersöka om traditionell utvärdering av molnarkitekturer, som bygger på kostnad och prestanda, kan utökas med en uppskattning av klimatpåverkan. Arbetet förväntas resultera i en praktisk och reproducerbar metod för att jämföra arkitekturer utifrån kostnad, prestanda och uppskattad klimatpåverkan. Det ska även innehålla en bedömning av den osäkerhet och de begränsningar som finns i sådana uppskattningar. Resultatet kan ge underlag för hur organisationer kan gå från övergripande hållbarhetsrapportering till välgrundade arkitekturbeslut, där kostnad, prestanda och miljöpåverkan vägs samman.
   

  

**En spännande resa med Knightec Group**
 Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det?
   

  

 Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling.
   

  

 På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt.
   

  

**Praktisk information**
 Detta är en masteruppsats-tjänst med placering på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Startdatum är i januari 2027, exakta datum släpps närmre inpå.
   

  

 Det färdiga examensarbetet kan publiceras och användas både i din personliga portfölj och i företagets marknadsföring. Vänligen bifoga CV och personligt brev i din ansökan.
   

  

 Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-29. Om du har några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Hibatallah Belhajali på Hibatallah.belhajali@knightec.se. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Anti-cheat
description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.
   

  

 We are now looking for a well rounded Data scientist to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for supporting our game teams with investigations into suspicious activities, performance analyses of detection rules, exploration of data and player behavior to design new rules. Your statistical background helps you identify significant patterns, and separate signals from noise. We operate in a complex environment where billions of telemetry events and other data are collected each day from all our games.
   

  

 You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You have a passion for data and technology, and feel excited to use your skills to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.
   

  

**Example Of Responsibilities**
* Perform ad-hoc investigations into suspicious patterns and gameplay behavior
* Work with game teams and customer support to verify and explain rule detections
* Support our Esport event teams with vetting of contestants
* Provide reports and performance analyses of our anti-cheat operation


**We would love if you have**
* A creative and curious mind.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database querying, preferably using tools such as BigQuery
* Proficiency in Python.
* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience working with ETLs and data pipelines.
* Experience in predictive modeling and analysis over large datasets
* Professional English communication skills.
* Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!


 At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
   

  

 We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.
   

  

 Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.
   

  

 Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Process Tools & Reporting Manager
description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
   

  

 With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
   

  

 Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.
   

  

 We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
   

  

 By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
   

  

**Process Tools & Reporting Manager at atNorth**
 This role is positioned at the intersection of sales, digital transformation, and operational excellence. You will define, develop, and continuously optimize how our Sales organization operates, ensuring scalable processes, strong system support, and high-quality data-driven decision-making.
   

  

 As a key member of the Sales Leadership Team, you will play a central role in enabling revenue growth, improving win rates, and strengthening customer retention by enhancing the efficiency, speed, and consistency of all customer-facing processes.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
 A key focus will be on building and governing a best-in-class sales operating model across all customer segments. You will lead the development and implementation of end-to-end sales processes, ensuring alignment across commercial, operational, and financial stakeholders.
   

  

 You will be responsible for defining and continuously improving the sales process framework, including lead management, qualification, bid processes, and contract handling, ensuring clarity, scalability, and strong adoption across the organization.
   

  

 From a systems and tools perspective, you will own the sales technology landscape, including CRM, reporting tools, and digital platforms. You will drive the use of data, automation, and AI to improve productivity, transparency, and decision-making across the sales funnel.
   

  

 You will lead the development of reporting structures and performance dashboards, ensuring clear visibility into pipeline, conversion rates, sales effectiveness, and overall commercial performance.
   

  

 Working cross-functionally, you will collaborate closely with IT, Finance, Business Control, and Operations to ensure that systems, data flows, and processes are aligned and support the company’s growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will also lead or support strategic transformation initiatives, including implementation of new tools, process standardization efforts, and continuous improvement programs across the commercial organization.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for a commercially minded and digitally strong leader who understands how to scale sales organizations through structured processes, systems, and data-driven insights.
   

  

**Your profile**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience within sales operations, commercial excellence, or similar roles
* Proven experience driving sales process optimization and implementing systems, tools, and reporting frameworks
* Experience working with digital transformation initiatives, including leveraging AI and automation
* Strong understanding of CRM systems, data structures, and reporting tools
* Experience working in international organizations and cross-functional environments
* Solid project management experience, including leading initiatives and stakeholders across functions
* Professional proficiency in English


 You are structured, analytical, and able to translate complexity into clear, scalable solutions. You combine a strong commercial mindset with a deep understanding of systems and data, and you are comfortable working across both strategic and operational levels.
   

  

 You are collaborative by nature and able to influence stakeholders across functions and seniority levels, driving alignment and adoption of new ways of working.
   

  

**Decision-making & impact**
 As a member of the Sales Leadership Team, you will have significant influence on how the commercial organization operates and scales. You will define standards, tools, and frameworks that directly impact sales performance, efficiency, and customer experience across all markets.
   

  

**About The AtNorth Culture**
 We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
   

  

 We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
   

  

 We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging.
   

  

 At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.
   

  

 #99

title: Product Operations Manager (Partners)
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 At Voi, we are on a mission to create safe, sustainable and accessible cities through shared micromobility. As Product Operations Manager in our Core Experience team, you will play a key role in how Voi connects with external partners, platforms and cities.
   

  

 You will join a cross-functional R&D team working closely with product, engineering and commercial stakeholders. In this role, you will own and develop Voi’s partner integrations and city data-sharing set-up, helping ensure our services are visible, reliable and easy to access across platforms such as Google Maps, FreeNow and for many of our +100 cities we operate in.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Act as the primary contact and account management for integration partners, building strong, collaborative relationships.
* Understand partner priorities, user needs, and city requirements to define and prioritize key opportunities.
* Assess city tender requirements to identify functional gaps and scalable technical solutions.
* Coordinate data-sharing initiatives with cities and partners using scalable, API-based integrations.
* Manage day-to-day operations for key integrations to drive partner visibility, conversion, and performance.
* Partner with your product team to build future partner tools and resolve daily technical inquiries.
* Communicate effectively across internal and external teams, translating complex technical topics into clear actions.


**What You Need To Embark**
 We are looking for a curious, structured and communicative person who enjoys working at the intersection of product, engineering and external partnerships. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable discussing technical concepts, asking the right questions and turning complex needs into clear actions.
   

  

**To Succeed In This Role, We Believe You Have**
* Technical curiosity and a basic understanding of software products, APIs and data analytics.
* Experience or interest in key account management, partner management or customer-facing ownership.
* Experience or strong interest in product operations, technical support or working closely with engineering and product teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* The ability to understand partner or customer needs and translate them into clear internal requirements or product improvements.
* Exposure to tenders, policy work, public-sector requirements, sales processes or product strategy is beneficial, but not required.


 Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t check every box.
   

  

**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This, You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups.
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: Divisional Lead TEKsystems Stockholm
description:
**För dig som vill bygga människor, affärer och resultat.**
 Nu söker TEKsystems i Stockholm en Divisional Lead till en internationell och marknadsledande organisation där du får möjlighet att kombinera strategiskt ledarskap med eget affärsansvar. Du kommer att leda ett duktigt säljteam samtidigt som du själv fortsätter att vara en aktiv och framgångsrik affärsutvecklare.
   

  

 Det här är en roll för dig som drivs av att utveckla människor, skapa starka kundrelationer och bygga högpresterande team.
   

  

**Om bolaget**
 TEKsystems är en ledande global leverantör av IT-konsulttjänster och specialanpassade team med över 100 kontor i Nordamerika, Europa och Asien. Vi är partners i transformation och hjälper kunder att aktivera idéer och lösningar för att dra nytta av en ny värld av möjligheter. Idag är vi över 80 000 personer som arbetar med mer än 6 000 kunder över hela världen. Vi levererar konkreta affärsresultat och skapar positiva avtryck i samhällen världen över. TEKsystems är ett bolag i Allegis Group.
   

  

**Rollen**
 Som Divisional Lead har du det övergripande ansvaret för att utveckla och driva en specialiserad affärsenhet. Som ledare skapar du förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom att inspirera, coacha och stötta medarbetarna samtidigt som du fungerar som en strategisk affärspartner för verksamheten. Parallellt fortsätter du att utveckla egna kundrelationer, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och bidra till verksamhetens fortsatta tillväxt.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Leda, coacha och utveckla ett säljteam
* Driva försäljningsstrategier och affärsutveckling inom din division
* Säkerställa att teamet når och överträffar uppsatta mål
* Bygga långsiktiga relationer med kunder och nyckelintressenter
* Utveckla teamets kompetens och skapa en kultur präglad av prestation, engagemang och samarbete
* Arbeta nära ledningen och bidra till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling


**Vem söker vi?**
 Du har sannolikt en bakgrund inom konsultförsäljning, rekryteringsförsäljning eller annan B2B-försäljning där du framgångsrikt kombinerat affärsmannaskap med ledarskap.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har:
   

  

* Dokumenterat goda resultat inom försäljning och affärsutveckling
* Erfarenhet av att leda, coacha eller utveckla säljare
* Förmåga att skapa engagemang och ansvarstagande i team
* Ett starkt affärsdriv och en naturlig förmåga att bygga långsiktiga relationer
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot högt uppsatta mål och tillväxtambitioner
* Pratar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska.


**Bli en del av TEKsystems**
 Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera ledarskap med affärsmannaskap i en organisation som präglas av entreprenörsanda, höga ambitioner och stark lagkänsla.
   

  

 Du får ett stort mandat att påverka både verksamhetens utveckling och ditt teams framgång. Här värdesätts initiativförmåga, resultatfokus och förmågan att utveckla människor. För rätt person finns goda möjligheter att växa vidare inom organisationen och ta ett ännu större ansvar över tid.
   

  

 Som en del av TEKsystems får du arbeta i en internationell miljö där prestation, samarbete och personlig utveckling står i centrum.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Denna rekrytering hanteras av Dreamwork för TEKsystems räkning. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid i Stockholm. Tillträde till tjänsten är enligt överenskommelse. Du söker tjänsten på www.poolia.se Bifoga CV och personligt brev.
   

  

 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Tjänsten kan därför komma tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten och TEKsystems är du välkommen att kontakta Christina Martinsson, ansvarig rekryterare på Dreamwork, 0735-180904 eller christina.martinsson@dreamwork.se

title: OT Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
Du som vill göra verklig skillnad för industri och samhälle genom smart cybersäkerhet i OT-miljöer kommer att trivas i den här rollen. Hos HiQ i Stockholm får du vara med där fabriker, energisystem och infrastruktur hålls i gång varje dag.
   

  

 Som OT Cybersecurity Specialist hos HiQ hjälper du kunder att skydda fabriker, energisystem och annan samhällskritisk infrastruktur. Du arbetar praktiskt i OT- och ICS-miljöer och är en viktig länk mellan drift, teknik och säkerhet. Rollen innebär att du både förstår processerna i anläggningen och kan omsätta regelverk och standarder till fungerande lösningar. I vardagen stöttar du både tekniska team och beslutsfattare och gör komplexa säkerhetsfrågor begripliga och hanterbara.
   

  

 Du kommer att:
   

  

* Genomföra risk och gap-analyser i OT- och ICS-miljöer och tydliggöra prioriteringar för kunden
* Designa och stödja implementering av säkerhetsarkitektur och skyddsåtgärder i industriella miljöer
* Arbeta med industriella nätverk, segmentering och säker fjärråtkomst i produktionsnära system
* Bidra till policyer, processer och styrning för OT-säkerhet och följa upp att de fungerar i praktiken
* Stödja kunder i audits, säkerhetsbedömningar och förbättringsprogram och följa upp åtgärder över tid


 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Teknisk examen inom till exempel maskin, mekatronik, cybersäkerhet, datateknik eller likvärdigt område
* Cirka sex års erfarenhet av OT- eller ICS-cybersäkerhet och praktiskt arbete i industriella miljöer, till exempel tillverkning, energi eller infrastruktur
* God förståelse för PLC, SCADA och DCS samt erfarenhet av industriella nätverk och protokoll
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med eller implementera säkerhetsstandarder och regelverk i OT miljöer
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift, samt svenskt medborgarskap
* Gärna erfarenhet av övervakning och incidenthantering i OT miljöer, brandväggar, IDS och IPS, tillgångsinventering, konsulterfarenhet och certifieringar som GICSP, CISSP eller CISM


 Varför HiQ?
   

  

 Hos HiQ får du jobba nära kunderna i uppdrag där OT säkerhet verkligen gör skillnad för både industri och samhälle. Du omges av kollegor som gärna delar kunskap, vilket gör det enkelt att både fördjupa dig inom OT och bredda dig mot områden som cybersäkerhet, moln och mjukvaruutveckling. Vi satsar på kontinuerligt lärande genom certifieringar, interna forum och uppdrag som utmanar dig på rätt nivå, och du vet att du har teamet i ryggen när du vill prova nya idéer eller ta nästa steg.
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

title: Teknikspecialist - Nätverk
description:
*Vill du arbeta brett med nätverk, säkerhet och automation i en komplex IT-miljö? Som teknikspecialist på Skandia får du en central roll i utvecklingen av vår datakommunikationsplattform och möjlighet att bidra till vår fortsatta automations- och moderniseringsresa.*
**Att jobba som teknikspecialist**
 Som teknikspecialist blir du en del av ett team med fem specialister som ansvarar för utveckling, förvaltning och support av Skandias infrastrukturnära plattformar. Tillsammans skapar ni stabila, säkra och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar för vår datakommunikation.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar operativt arbete med teknisk utveckling. Du arbetar bland annat med drift, felsökning, incident- och changehantering samt automation. I nära samarbete med arkitekter, andra IT-team och leverantörer omsätter du behov till tekniska lösningar och bidrar genom hela processen – från analys och design till genomförande och förvaltning.
   

  

 Du arbetar i en bred nätverksmiljö som omfattar bland annat LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, WLAN, VPN, molnanslutningar, nätsegmentering, DNS, DHCP, IPAM och lastbalansering. I vår teknikmiljö finns bland annat Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto, Cisco ISE, F5, Infoblox, Broadcom WSS och Meinberg.
   

  

 Vi använder även Ansible Automation Platform för att automatisera och effektivisera vår nätverksinfrastruktur.
   

  

 I denna roll ingår det att vara del av en beredskapskedja ca var 6e vecka.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Vi söker dig som har ett intresse för nätverk och som vill kombinera teknisk specialistkompetens med problemlösning och utveckling. Du är van att ta ansvar, analysera komplexa problem och driva frågor framåt.
   

  

**Vi Ser Att Du Har**
* ett par års erfarenhet av drift, felsökning, förvaltning och utveckling av datakommunikationslösningar
* djup teknisk förståelse för nätverk, säkerhet och relaterade plattformar
* erfarenhet av att omsätta behov och krav till tekniska lösningar
* förmåga att kommunicera och samarbeta med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära roller
* eftergymnasial utbildning inom data- eller systemvetenskap, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* vana av att arbeta med infrastruktur som kod och/eller automation är starkt meriterande


**Vad händer nu?**
 I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.
   

  

 Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Alexander Larre på alexander.larre@skandia.se.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Process Specialist - Additive Manufacturing
description:
Requisition ID: 25444
Job Category: Engineering & Technology
Career level: Specialist
Contract type: Permanent
Location:
Gothenburg, SE  

**Innovation starts with curiosity. Meaningful progress starts with execution.**



Join SKF! We are looking for a

  


**Senior Process Specialist – Additive Manufacturing**


**Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF)**

  



As a Senior Process Specialist within Additive Manufacturing, you will play a key role in developing, qualifying, and industrializing Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) processes for metallic materials and applications. The primary focus of the role is to bridge technology development with product and manufacturing implementation, ensuring robust, scalable and cost-effective additive manufacturing solutions that support SKF’s growth ambitions.



You will act as a technical expert in additive manufacturing, driving process qualification, manufacturing readiness, product introduction and continuous process improvement. In your daily work you will work closely with product development, manufacturing, quality and researchers to support additive manufacturing in large.

  


**Your Day-to-day work/ Key Responsibilities**


* Manage process development activities related to the L-PBF process with a clear focus on process qualification in close collaboration with product development.
* Develop and implement methodologies for process verification and quality assurance, e.g. by utilizing advanced process monitoring and quality assurance software for in-process control and defect detection.
* Contribute to the advancement of additive manufacturing capabilities and technologies within SKF. Specific focus will be on running Proof-of-Concept activities with related prototype development.
* Stay up to date on technical development and know-how with respect to additive manufacturing, and to make sure this knowledge is spread within the organization.

  


**We expect you to have/be**


* Master’s degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or similar with minimum 5 years of hands-on industrial experience with L-PBF technology and metal additive manufacturing. PhD in Additive Manufacturing and Materials Science, or related field, will be considered an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in taking additive manufacturing processes and applications from development into industrial implementation, including process qualification, production readiness, and cross-functional product realization activities.
* In-depth practical experience and a deep understanding of the L-PBF machine and related operation, calibration, troubleshooting, and process development, where optimization for medium- and high carbon steels will be considered an advantage.
* Experience from process monitoring and quality assurance software used in additive manufacturing.
* Proficiency in CAD and design tools relevant to additive manufacturing, where experience in Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) will be considered an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  


**You will enjoy working here if you**


* Have a curious mindset and a passion for technology development and innovation.
* Have sound analytical and problem-solving skills and a structured and data-driven approach to engineering challenges.
* Thrive from working with skilled colleagues from across disciplines with capabilities covering the full manufacturing process chain.

  


**What you’ll love about SKF…**


* **A culture of diversity and inclusion!**

*SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF*
* **Fair and transparent compensation!**

*We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.*  


**Some additional information**



This position is located in **Gothenburg**, Sweden, on a local contract.

  

  

You will report to the Manager, Steel, Heat Treatment & NDT and Principal Engineer, Manufacturing Technology, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Kristina Ryttberg by phone/Teams/email.



For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa who is located in Schweinfurt, Germany at katrin.edelmann@skf.com. *Please note that we can't accept applications via email*.

  


**Is this you?**  

If the answer is yes, submit your application in English no later than **October-23-2026**. *Please note that we can't accept applications via email*.

  


*To support a transparent process, we may include assessments and before hiring we can verify the information in your application in compliance with country-specific laws and regulations.*

title: Project Planner/Engineer
description:
Description At Aquatech, we tackle the challenges of water scarcity and complexity by leveraging technology, expertise, and financing to deliver comprehensive solutions that reduce carbon and recycled water footprint. title: Development Engineer – Power Electronics
description:
Development Engineer – Power Electronics Lund, Sweden | Comsys AB About Comsys Comsys AB is a Swedish cleantech company based in Lund, developing advanced solutions for power quality and energy efficiency. Our products help industries and critical infrastructure use electricity more reliably and efficiently, addressing complex challenges such as harmonics, resonance, flicker and load imbalance. At the heart of our technology is our patented Active Dynamic Filtering (ADF) technology. With more than 20 years of experience and customers in over 50 countries, Comsys is continuously pushing the boundaries of power electronics and developing high-performance solutions for demanding industrial applications.
  
  

At Comsys, engineering is at the core of what we do. You will work in a highly cross-functional environment,collaborating across disciplines such as software, electronics, FPGA and systems engineering to turn complex technology into robust, high-performance products. https://comsys.se Want to develop technology that makes a real difference? Now we are looking for a Development Engineer – Power Electronics to join our team in Lund.
  
  

The role As an Electronics Development Engineer, you will play an important role throughout the entire product development lifecycle – from early concepts and circuit design to prototype verification, industrialization, and product support. This is a hands-on role where you will combine engineering knowledge with practical problem-solving. You will work closely with colleagues across hardware, software, systems, and mechanical engineering to turn ideas into robust, high-performance products. Your responsibilities will include: Developing electronic hardware for our power electronics products Designing electronics at circuit, PCBA, and PCB level Designing, building, and verifying prototypes Performing laboratory work, measurements, testing, and troubleshooting Working with EMC design and verification Collaborating closely with system, software, and mechanical engineers Contributing to product development from concept through production and customer support Applying relevant IEC standards and supporting CE compliance Who you are You are an engineer who enjoys understanding how things work – and then making them work better.
  
  

You are comfortable moving between schematic design, the lab, measurements, debugging, and discussions with colleagues from other disciplines. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving technical challenges, and are not afraid to get hands-on when a prototype does not behave as expected. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and communicate effectively in an international environment. We believe you have: An M.Sc.
  
  

in Electrical Engineering or a related field Experience in electronic hardware design and power electronics Experience with active filters, variable frequency drives, or other power electronics is highly desirable. Hands-on experience with laboratory work, testing, measurements, and troubleshooting Experience with Altium Designer Knowledge of EMC design and verification Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken Familiarity with IEC standards and CE compliance Experience from industrial product development is highly valued. We are particularly interested in someone who wants to work close to the technology and see their designs become real products. Interested in perfecting power with us?
  
  

In this recruitment, we are partnering with Jenny Månsson at Radeptus. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact her at jenny@adeptus.se or +46 703 318 506. Please submit your application via the application link only (applications sent by email will not be considered) We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Diagnostics Design & Verification Engineer
description:

At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com . Are you passionate about building robust, intelligent diagnostic systems for next‑generation automotive technologies? We’ve created a workplace where you, as an employee, are always at the center. In everything we do, we strive for a high level of involvement and responsiveness to our employees' thoughts about their future roles and careers. Define diagnostic concepts, monitoring strategies, and mitigation mechanisms. Develop detailed system and software diagnostic requirements in accordance with ASPICE (SYS/SWE).
  
  

Structure, configure, and maintain DTCs (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) and UDS services. Ensure compliance with key automotive standards: ISO 14229, SAE J2012, SAE 1979. Design, implement, and execute diagnostic test cases for embedded systems. Specify datapoints for backend analytics, predictive maintenance, and fleet insights.

Familiarity with Linux/WSL environments. Valid Swedish B‑category driving license. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with AUTOSAR and POSIX-based environments. Knowledge of aftermarket onboard diagnostics and service‑oriented tooling.
  
  

Understanding of emission‑related monitor design and OBD legislation. Background in system architecture development and/or project management. Who are we?At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life, and we’re building a culture where you can: Be Dedicated Be Brave and Curious Be Inclusive and Allowing We believe that real talent lies in those who dare to keep growing throughout life. With deep industry knowledge and years of experience, we’ve built a forward-thinking company – in our own way.
  
  

Your application If you are driven by technical depth, system level thinking, and solving real-world diagnostic challenges, we would love to hear from you! For questions about the position, feel free to contact Patrik Artman, 0733-908035 or patrik.artman@mpyascitech.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
**Senior Product Engineer**  

Build a product with real users and AI in production, in a small team that owns the problem end to end. SeenThis is turning campaign work that today lives across email, spreadsheets, ad platforms and people’s heads into software that can increasingly run it. We organise Product and Engineering in small teams around the problems that matter most, and give each team the mandate to make its own decisions.


You’ll join one of those teams: a few engineers, a designer and a product manager. The team works directly with customers, decides what to build, ships it, runs it and measures whether it worked. As the senior engineer, you shape the architecture and the technical approach, including how AI features are built and tested, while spending most of your time building. The team starts on Creative Manager.

**About SeenThis**
==================


The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent. Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries. We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open.  

  

Our team of 130+ employees works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York, and Sydney. We're expanding across all teams and constantly seeking new colleagues who want to make real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where innovation happens daily.  

  

Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it, and win together?  

Join SeenThis!

**About the role**
==================


Getting a video campaign live means keeping a brand, its agencies and several ad platforms aligned, and much of that coordination is still done by hand. Creative Manager brings the media plan, specifications, assets, approvals and publishing into one shared workflow. Design partners already run real campaigns through it, and many of the important product and technical decisions are still open. The next step is to make it a product any agency can rely on every day.


The hard part is making the open web as simple to buy as a walled garden. A walled garden has one platform and one set of rules. On the open web, every agency structures campaigns differently, every ad platform and publisher has its own formats and requirements, and several roles work on the same campaign. The product has to absorb that complexity without exposing it to the user. Getting the domain model, integrations and permissions right is what makes that possible, and what lets AI take on more of the coordination over time.


Early work might include:

* Completing the path from approval to publishing across the ad platforms our partners use.
* Using AI to read media plans in whatever format an agency sends, with evals behind it and clear signals to the user where it is unsure.
* Handling hundreds of assets per campaign, with bulk changes and naming conventions.

**How we work**
===============

* Stay close to the problem. Engineers spend time with customers and our campaign producers alongside product and design, so the people building the product understand the workflow, the edge cases and why the problem matters. Discovery is shared work, and we explore options with prototypes before committing to a solution.
* Small teams, full ownership. The team decides how to solve the problem, how to structure the system and how to get it into production, and ownership continues after the code is merged. There is no separate architecture group handing down solutions.
* Ship early and measure. We get something useful in front of users quickly, measure what happens and improve from there. Campaigns have fixed deadlines, so reliability, observability and recovery are part of product development from the start.
* Use AI in the tools and in the product. We use Claude Code, Codex and other AI tools heavily in development, and engineers remain accountable for what ships. When AI is part of a product workflow, we treat evals, uncertainty, guardrails and failure modes as engineering problems in their own right.
* Follow the problem across boundaries. A product problem might start in the UI and lead into an API, the domain model, an integration, the data platform or the streaming infrastructure that handles billions of events a day. We expect engineers to follow it far enough to solve it properly.

**Qualifications**
==================

* You’ve taken customer-facing products from an unclear starting point into production and run them long enough to see which of your decisions held up.
* You’re a full-stack engineer in practice: you build complex UI flows for expert users and design the domain model, APIs and integrations behind them, with solid habits in performance, testing and failure handling.
* You bring product judgment to engineering: you understand how users actually work, and you know when to invest in foundations and when to ship something simpler.
* You use AI coding tools in your daily work, can explain how you verify their output, and can reason through a system and debug it without them.
* You raise the standard of the team through design reviews, code review and clear written reasoning.


For reference, we build in TypeScript, with Vue, Node and PostgreSQL. With AI tools, a new stack is quick to pick up, so we hire for judgment and fundamentals rather than experience with specific frameworks.

**Bonus if you have experience with**
=====================================


Creative or content production tools, advertising technology, complex B2B workflows, third-party platform integrations, high-volume event data or video delivery. Or LLM features in production.

**Application**
===============


As we review applications and interview on a continuous basis, please apply as soon as possible. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to provide personalized feedback prior to the interview stage. Thank you for understanding!  

  

We conduct background checks on all SeenThis-hires to comply with our customers and protect business-critical information.


We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis!

title: Design Engineer
description:
**Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.**


GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.


**Job Summary**
---------------


Are you an enthusiastic Design Engineer eager to shape the future of commercial aircraft engines? At GKN Aerospace Sweden, our Design and Configuration Management is home to a talented team of engineers who design and develop cutting-edge products for aero engine applications. We’re seeking a motivated and skilled individual to join us—whether you’re early in your career or bring years of experience, your passion for design engineering is what drives us forward.
  

In this role, you’ll work within high-performing teams, contributing to all phases of the product life cycle. You’ll create innovative design solutions that meet GKN Aerospace Sweden’s rigorous standards, Operational Management System (OMS), and technical product requirements.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


As a Design Engineer, you’ll play a key role in delivering world-class engineering solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  

* Design Creation & Management: Develop and update design data, including product drawings, CAD models, and geometrical interfaces, using Siemens PLM (Teamcenter) and NX software.
* Data Oversight: Store, maintain, and release design data in Siemens Teamcenter.
* Design Innovation: Conduct design studies, implement changes, and create geometrical interface documentation while justifying updates to requirements.
* Technical Precision: Perform tolerance stack-ups to ensure robust and reliable designs.
  

We’re looking for someone with exceptional Computer-Aided Design (CAD) skills and a strong understanding of robust engineering principles. You’ll balance performance, cost, quality, and constraints from production and other disciplines to deliver outstanding results.


**Qualifications & Personal skills**
------------------------------------


You’re a proactive individual who thrives both independently and as part of a collaborative team. You’re confident communicating with colleagues across the company and external stakeholders, and you excel at analyzing results and presenting them clearly to diverse audiences.

  

  

**Essential Qualifications:**


* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Proficiency with CAD/PLM tools, specifically Siemens Teamcenter and NX.
* Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) standards (ASME Y14.5 and ISO).
* Fluency in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.
* 5+ years of experience as a design engineer.
  

**Desirable Qualifications:**


* Experience in geometry assurance.
* Background in product support or product development.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as investment casting, welding, heat treatment, etc.
**Application**

At GKN Aerospace Sweden, you’ll be part of a dynamic team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of aero engine technology. Whether you’re just starting out or bringing seasoned expertise, this is your chance to grow, innovate, and make an impact in a supportive and high-performing environment.

Susanne Boderos- Engineering Manager, Tel: +46 700871438

title: Development Engineer - Heat Pump Systems
description:
At Electrolux Professional Group we hire to meet needs beyond tomorrow!


**UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL**

At Electrolux Professional Group, we believe potential powers progress. We’re not searching for perfection—we’re looking for people with the right mindset. If you're curious, resilient, and ready to grow, you'll find the space to lead, innovate, and together with us Meet the needs beyond tomorrow. Read more about us here: https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/join-us/  



  

**DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER – HEAT PUMP SYSTEMS**

Do you have a passion for heat pump technology, thermodynamics, and developing innovative products? If so, this could be an opportunity for you.


We are looking for a Development Engineer to join our R&D team and contribute to the development of next-generation heat pump technology for tumble dryers. In this role, you will be driving testing, verification, and performance improvements to ensure quality, functionality, and reliability before products reach the market.
  

  

In this role, you will be a key player in shaping the next generation of sustainable energy solutions.  



  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**  

  

As a Development Engineer for the heat pump systems, your main responsibility is to plan, execute, and evaluate tests on heat pump systems and drying technologies. You will analyze performance data, identify improvement opportunities, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to the development of innovative and sustainable solutions.


Other responsibilities:


* Investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements.
* Contribute to the optimization and continuous improvement of heat pump-based products.
* Verify new technical solutions and concepts.
* Document test results and communicate findings to stakeholders.
* Work with measurement equipment, data acquisition systems, and validation methods.
* Participate in development projects together with design and systems engineers.
* Collaborate closely with colleagues in R&D, software development, electronics, production, laboratory operations, etc.
Ensure products meet requirements for quality, functionality, and reliability.  
* 

**WHAT'S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE**  

  

To succeed in this role, we would like to see that you have genuine interest and passion for working with heat pumps. We believe that you have worked as a Development Engineer, Test Engineer, Verification Engineer, or R&D Engineer within heat pumps, refrigeration systems, HVAC, or related technical fields. You have several years of hands-on experience testing thermodynamic systems and enjoy working closely to the product to solve technical challenges and drive improvements.


As a person, you are a proactive and analytical engineer with a strong drive to understand complex systems and turn insights into practical solutions. You take initiative, challenge the status quo, and use data-driven analysis to identify opportunities that enhance product quality, performance, and reliability.


Qualifications:


* A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Thermodynamics, Refrigeration Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Hands-on experience with heat pumps, refrigeration systems, HVAC, or similar thermal systems, combined with a strong understanding of thermodynamics and heat pump processes.
* Experience from a laboratory, testing, verification, or product development environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.  
* 

Advantageous qualifications:


* Experience developing white goods, heat pumps, refrigeration products, or HVAC systems.
* Experience with data acquisition systems and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of PLC programming, automation, control systems, or electrical systems.
Swedish language skills.  
* 

  

*To be eligible for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in Sweden. We are unable to offer work permit sponsorship.*  



**OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES**  

Be Customer Obsessed. Build Trust. Be Bold. Act Sustainably. We’re building it every day — and we’d love your help.
  

  

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**

Join a company where innovation, sustainability, and engineering excellence go hand in hand. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced heat pump technology, contribute to products that reduce energy consumption, and see your ideas translated into real-world solutions.


You'll be trusted with responsibility from day one and become part of a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and personal growth are highly valued.

title: Mechanical Test Development Engineer
description:
**Mechanical Test Development Engineer**
========================================


**Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.**


**About the Role**
------------------


Realheart is strengthening its Engineering team ahead of the next stage in the company’s development. As a Mechanical Test Development Engineer, you will play an important role in developing test methods and equipment for a Total Artificial Heart.


This is an opportunity to join a company at the forefront of research within life-saving medical technology. You will contribute with your technical expertise in a collaborative team, where careful testing, continuous improvement and high-quality documentation are essential to moving development forward.


You will develop and implement test equipment and methods for medical devices, validate test methods, and perform testing within both R&D and production. The role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams and internal and external stakeholders to ensure that testing is well planned, traceable and fit for purpose.


**About You**
-------------


You are an experienced engineer with a practical approach to test development and a strong interest in solving technical challenges. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work while enjoying close collaboration with colleagues from different disciplines. You have strong planning, prioritisation and coordination skills.


To succeed in the role, you combine analytical thinking with attention to detail and a structured way of working. You understand the importance of clear technical documentation, traceability and maintaining high-quality standards. You can plan, prioritise and coordinate your work effectively when several activities are running in parallel.


**What we Offer**
-----------------


You will become part of a growing team at a pivotal point in Realheart’s development. The role offers the chance to contribute directly to the continued development of advanced medical technology with the potential to make a meaningful difference for patients.


Here, you will work hands-on with test development while collaborating across functions and contributing to the methods and equipment needed for the next steps in the development journey. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.


**Application**
---------------


We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from **18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026.**

For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64. Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date


**Requirements**
----------------


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Biomedical or a related engineering field
* At least five years of industry experience, preferbly within medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
* Enjoys and have solid hands-on experience of designing and developing test methods and test equipment.
* Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
* Proficiency in 3D CAD (Realheart uses SolidWorks) and mechanical design.
* Strong spoken and written English.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience from the medical device industry or another regulated industry
* Familiarity with FDA regulations (21 CFR 820), ISO 13485 and ISO 14971
* Experience using design of experiments (DOE), quality assurance software tools and statistical methods

**About Scandinavian Real Heart**
---------------------------------


Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?


Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many  

patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution.


Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team  

placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

title: VP Engineer
description:
**About VetFamily**
VetFamily is part of Vimian Group, a global veterinary healthcare group listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. VetFamily is the partner to close to 12,000 independent veterinary clinics in 14 countries, providing purchasing, technology, and business services that give clinics scale, better terms, and less administration.


VetFamily has grown rapidly since its inception in 2001, organically and through several acquisitions and operates in a decentralised, entrepreneurial structure, while technology is developed centrally.


The culture is collaborative, down-to-earth and entrepreneurial. People care about what they do, about each other and, naturally, about animals.


**About the role**
We are looking for a **VP Engineering** to lead our engineering organisation and drive the technical agenda forward.


The role combines engineering leadership, technical direction and business partnership. You will lead the organisation while staying close to the technology, with responsibility for architecture, modernisation, delivery and technical quality.


Our core platform moves billions in transactions a year across EMEA, the US and Australia. Fast growth and acquisitions made it powerful and complicated in equal measure. You are here to modernise it while the teams keep shipping.


AI is central to the technology agenda. The organisation is already using AI in development, with ambitions to take this further into AI-native engineering and agentic capabilities in our products.


At HQ, engineering supports VetPlan, our preventive care subscription product; Data Engineering, the group’s data and analytics platform; Clinic Experience, our clinic-facing products and member portal; and our AI agentic development team.

**In this role you will:**

* Lead and develop the engineering organisation through team leads and senior engineers
* Drive architecture, technical direction and platform modernisation
* Advance AI adoption and agentic development
* Develop the data platform and explore data monetisation opportunities
* Support technical due diligence and technology integration in acquisitions
* Improve engineering processes, ways of working and delivery
* Manage technology resources, vendors and partners


Four teams, three languages in production, and a data platform built on Snowflake and dbt. Some of that breadth is deliberate, some of it is history. Deciding what to keep, what to change and where to create consistency is part of the job.  

  

The role is based in Stockholm, with colleagues also in France and Germany.


**What we're looking for**
You are an experienced engineering leader with **strong technical depth, business understanding and a hands-on approach**. You have led engineering organisations through growth and change and are comfortable combining people leadership with technical responsibility.

**We are looking for:**

* Experience leading engineering teams through team leads and/or engineering managers, including hiring, development and performance
* A background as a software engineer or architect, with the technical depth to challenge senior developers and engage in architecture and implementation decisions
* Experience modernising complex, business-critical technology while maintaining delivery
* Strong practical experience with AI in software engineering, and a clear perspective on AI and agentic technology
* The ability to connect technical decisions to business priorities and commercial outcomes
* Experience working with complex data environments and/or data-driven products
* An entrepreneurial, hands-on and collaborative approach to leadership
* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field, or equivalent experience

**Nice to have:**

* Experience from SaaS, subscription or data-driven businesses
* Experience from an international or decentralised organisation
* Experience with M&A, technical due diligence or technology integration
* Experience from veterinary, healthcare or a related industry – or a genuine interest in animals and veterinary care

**What we offer**
* **Real influence.** A broad engineering mandate, close access to the management team and a direct connection to the business.
* **Meaningful technical challenges.** Modernisation, data and AI across a complex international platform.
* **Room to build.** An organisation that is still evolving, with scope to shape both technology and engineering.
* **A collaborative workplace.** A down-to-earth culture, an international team and a modern office in central Stockholm.
* **A meaningful mission.** Helping independent veterinary clinics remain strong and supporting better animal healthcare.

title: Erfaren Salesforceutvecklare till Handelsbanken
description:
**Var med och forma framtidens CRM i Handelsbanken**
 Vill du vara med och vidareutveckla Handelsbankens CRM? Vi söker en erfaren Salesforceutvecklare som vill vara med på resan när vi tar CRM-plattformen till nästa nivå.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av ett nytt Salesforce-team på Handelsbanken som består av Salesforceutvecklare, Business Analysts, testare, Product Owner och Team Coach. Teamet har ett strategiskt viktigt uppdrag och du får möjlighet att vara med från början och påverka såväl arbetssätt som tekniska lösningar. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att leverera funktionalitet som stödjer Handelsbankens CRM-lösning baserad på Salesforce.
   

  

 Vi arbetar i tvärfunktionella agila team och du kommer att samarbeta nära utvecklare och arkitekter, både inom och utanför vårt område. Vi har roligt på jobbet och vårt team präglas av hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet inom både teknik och affärsverksamhet.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Du blir en del av ett nytt team med ett strategiskt viktigt uppdrag: att skapa en samlad kundbild som hjälper verksamheten att fatta bättre beslut och leverera mer relevanta kundupplevelser. Som en del av teamet får du möjlighet att vara med och påverka både arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar från start.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta nära verksamheten och tillsammans med teamet identifiera behov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar som skapar affärsvärde. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i gränslandet mellan affär, data och teknik, samtidigt som du ser tydliga resultat av det du bygger.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare med gedigen kunskap om Salesforce-plattformen. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du gärna samarbetar med andra för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Du har erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla användarvänliga, effektiva och skalbara Salesforce-lösningar enligt etablerade best practices.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemvetenskap, datateknik, informationssystem eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling på Salesforce-plattformen.
* Erfarenhet av Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex Controllers, Batch Apex, Schedulers och Apex Triggers.


 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet av Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Erfarenhet av REST- och SOAP-integrationer.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, versionshantering och moderna utvecklingsprocesser.
* Erfarenhet av större Salesforce-implementationer, gärna inom bank och finans.
* Erfarenhet av reglerade verksamheter med höga krav på säkerhet, integritet och efterlevnad.
* Salesforce-certifieringar, exempelvis Platform Developer I eller II.


 Som person trivs du med att samarbeta och tror på att de bästa lösningarna skapas tillsammans. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, stöttar dina kollegor och bidrar till att teamet når sina gemensamma mål.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken och lösningsorienterad, och har en naturlig förmåga att tänka nytt för att skapa effektiva och skalbara lösningar. Du håller dig uppdaterad inom Salesforce-ekosystemet och omvärldsbevakar kontinuerligt för att hitta nya möjligheter och bästa möjliga lösningar.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

 Per Almshult, per.almshult@handelsbanken.se
